title: BGTask handler awaits an XPC reply before arming its expiration handler — hang kills the process and latches scheduling off
description:
Found 2026-07-28 by a read-only continuation audit prompted by playhead-xc6b's finding that .timeLimit cannot unwind a body parked on withCheckedContinuation with no cancellation handler. This is the shipping-code instance of that class, and the highest-blast-radius one of four found.

THE SITE: BackgroundProcessingService.swift:113 — the withCheckedContinuation bridging BGTaskScheduler.getPendingTaskRequests. Resumed by an out-of-process daemon (dasd) reply. No timeout, no withTaskCancellationHandler.

THE PATH: handleBackfillTask (:1057) calls await scheduleBackfillIfNeeded() at :1101. That method sets backfillRescheduleInFlight = true with a defer reset (:869-871), then awaits taskScheduler.pendingTaskRequestIdentifiers() at :873, parking on :113. THE EXPIRATION HANDLER IS NOT INSTALLED UNTIL :1233 — after this await.

CONSEQUENCE IF THE REPLY IS LOST: no setTaskCompleted, no armed expirationHandler, so iOS terminates the process AND penalises future scheduling; and because the defer at :869-871 never runs, backfillRescheduleInFlight stays true, so ALL further backfill/feed-refresh rescheduling is dead for the process lifetime. A single lost XPC reply degrades into permanent scheduler death until relaunch.

Same shape in BackgroundFeedRefreshService.scheduleNextRefresh (:531), reached from runRefreshOnce (:797). MITIGATING (verified): handleFeedRefreshTask (:635) uses scheduleNextRefresh(force: true), which returns at :521 BEFORE the continuation — so the feed-refresh handler ENTRY is already clear; only its runRefreshOnce-internal backfill hop (:797) and the non-forced periodic path (:489) are exposed.

FIX: wrap the continuation in withTaskCancellationHandler AND add a hard timeout. Resume with [] — fail OPEN to 'nothing pending', which merely causes a redundant re-submit — rather than throwing, because callers treat the result as advisory. A 'once' guard is REQUIRED because the timeout and the callback can race. SECONDARY FIX: move the await scheduleBackfillIfNeeded() in handleBackfillTask to AFTER the expirationHandler install at :1233, so an OS reclaim during a hang is still reportable.

Related: playhead-xc6b (where the failure class was identified), and the sibling sites TranscriptEngine.swift:328, PlayheadRuntime.swift:33, TranscriptEngineService.swift:669.
acceptance_criteria: The getPendingTaskRequests bridge cannot park indefinitely: it has a cancellation handler and a hard timeout, with a once-guard so timeout and callback cannot double-resume. A test proves a never-arriving reply resolves to the fail-open empty result rather than hanging, and that backfillRescheduleInFlight is released either way. The expirationHandler is armed before any awaited work in handleBackfillTask, proven by a source canary or an ordering test.
notes:
2026-07-28 DAN RATIFIED the accepted behaviour change: fail-open on cancel is the right call.

WHAT IT IS: because the reschedule now lives inside the cancellable work task, an expiration landing while the bridge is querying makes it fail open — which defeats the playhead-txq3 / playhead-i6oi pending-request guard for that ONE fire, and age-resets backfillProcessingCharged's earliestBeginDate by 60s.

WHY IT IS CORRECT (Dan agreed): the handler is running BECAUSE the plain identifier just dispatched, so it is genuinely no longer pending and re-arming is the right action. A redundant submit beats skipping the re-arm on the one path where re-arming matters most.

RECORDED SO NOBODY 'FIXES' IT LATER: a future reader will find a fail-open that appears to defeat a deliberate guard and may try to close it. The cheap close would be a 'guard !Task.isCancelled' before the charged sibling's submitWithTelemetry — do NOT add it without revisiting this reasoning. The same fail-open-on-cancel applies at AnalysisWorkScheduler.swift:1014 during shutdown, where a redundant submit is harmless.
close_reason: Merged to main as ae966824. The bridge is bounded and the expiration handler is armed first. Adds Playhead/Support/BoundedContinuation.swift, a generic cancellable timeout-bounded wrapper built DELIBERATELY REUSABLE so the sibling sites (playhead-8m2w, playhead-2gka) adopt it rather than hand-rolling three more once-guards. ONCE GUARD: every resolution — daemon callback, timeout, onCancel, and a framework double-fire — funnels through one lock-protected state machine, transitioning phase UNDER the lock and resuming OUTSIDE it so a synchronous callback cannot re-enter a non-reentrant lock; a fourth phase handles resolution BEFORE the continuation exists, since withTaskCancellationHandler invokes onCancel immediately when the task is already cancelled on entry. Proven by 200 iterations with the timeout jittered 0/25/50/75us against four competing resumers (a double resume traps the bundle, so completion IS the assertion). TIMEOUT 2s, chosen from the TIGHTEST caller not the biggest: appDidEnterBackground() runs this on the .background transition where iOS grants ~5s before suspension; the BGProcessingTask window is minutes, so anything >=5s would protect the foreground path not at all. Fails OPEN to 'nothing pending' so a timeout costs a redundant re-submit rather than a missed re-arm. LATCH proved by consequence (submit count 2->4->6 across three consecutive timeouts — a stuck latch makes calls 2 and 3 submit nothing). Self-review caught its own canary blind spot: the first version elided if/guard/for/switch bodies along with Task bodies, so an await added inside a control-flow block before arming would have been invisible to the very canary guarding that regression. 16 new tests, budget 5/14.

title: Configure SwiftLint: adopt a checked-in .swiftlint.yml and wire it into the gate
description:
Dan 2026-07-26. SwiftLint is INSTALLED on this box (/opt/homebrew/bin/swiftlint) but the repo has NO .swiftlint.yml, so it never runs and 'lint' is a no-op step in every implementer/reviewer prompt and every bead gate. Today the Swift compiler is the only static check we have.

WHY NOW: the i08e review loop repeatedly hit the absence — 'lint: (none configured — skip)' — meaning style/dead-code/complexity regressions land unreviewed and reviewers spend rounds on things a linter would catch mechanically.

SCOPE:
- Add a checked-in .swiftlint.yml at repo root, tuned to this codebase rather than stock defaults (this repo has 5,000-line test files and long actor types; a stock config would emit thousands of violations and be ignored, which is worse than no linter).
- Start with a SMALL enabled rule set that is already ~clean, so the baseline is green on day one. Grow it deliberately.
- Decide and document the failure policy: warnings-only initially, then promote specific rules to errors once clean.
- Wire it into scripts/fast-gate.sh (or a sibling scripts/lint.sh) so 'lint' becomes a real command the bead workflow can call, and update CLAUDE.md's testing section + the iterative-implementation prompt's lint slot.
- Exclude generated/vendored paths (Playhead.xcodeproj, Playhead/Resources/Models, TestFixtures, .worktrees, .derivedData).

EXPLICIT NON-GOAL: do not do a repo-wide autocorrect sweep in the same change. A giant reformat commit would collide with every open bead worktree (there are 6 live ones) and destroy git blame. Land the config + gate wiring first; schedule cleanup rule-by-rule after.

CAUTION: any rule that triggers mass reformatting must be introduced on a quiet branch with no other beads in flight.
acceptance_criteria: A .swiftlint.yml is checked in and 'swiftlint lint' exits 0 on a clean checkout of main (baseline green, not a wall of violations). A documented lint command exists that the bead workflow can invoke, and CLAUDE.md's Testing section names it alongside the fast-gate. The enabled rule set and the warnings-vs-errors policy are written down with rationale. Generated/vendored paths are excluded. No mass-reformat in this change; any rule needing a sweep is listed as a follow-up with its own bead.
notes:
2026-07-27 DAN: schedule this for a QUIET REPO — do it only when no other bead worktrees are open and nothing else is in flight. Rationale: SwiftLint is the one bead whose changes can touch every file. Any rule that triggers a reformat would collide with every open worktree and destroy git blame across them, and the resulting merge conflicts would land on other people's in-flight work rather than on this bead. The scope discipline in the description (config + gate wiring ONLY, no repo-wide autocorrect sweep, cleanup rule-by-rule afterward) still applies even in a quiet window — the quiet window makes it SAFER, not a licence to sweep.

TIMING: the natural window is right after a merge when .worktrees/ is empty. Check 'git worktree list' shows only the main checkout before starting.
2026-07-27 DAN: implement this bead with the iterative-implementation-with-review-loops skill (implementer subagent, then FRESH reviewer subagents that FIX what they find, until TWO CONSECUTIVE zero-finding rounds; cap 20 per this repo's convention, not the skill's default 5).

APPLY THE COST PROTOCOL learned on playhead-i08e (see memory feedback_review_loop_economics_2026-07-27) — without it rounds balloon to ~85 min each:
- Give every round a HARD BUILD BUDGET (12-16 xcodebuild invocations) and require it to report usage.
- FULL GATE EXACTLY ONCE, at the end of a round, on the final committed state. Validate everything else against focused suites. Running the full gate mid-round adds no information and costs ~5.5 min a time.
- COMMIT AFTER EVERY DISCRETE STEP. Rounds get interrupted; uncommitted work is lost work.
- Don't re-derive known checks by hand — scripts/mutation-battery.sh (on main) runs the established battery in one command.
- MUTATE, DON'T READ: a finding you cannot demonstrate with a surviving mutation probably isn't one; a mutation that survives the gate definitely is. On i08e, three separate rounds found mutations surviving the whole ~8.5k-test gate, and one round's confident 'zero findings' was later proved wrong.
Measured costs on this box: warm no-op focused run 68s; focused run after touching a production file 85s; full gate ~5.5 min; whole battery 10 builds/~17 min.

Every round must set DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode-beta.app/Contents/Developer, never pipe a gate through a mask (a pipeline returns the LAST exit code, so a failed gate reads as 0), and never run two xcodebuild processes concurrently (16 GB box; the loser is OOM-killed with no test failure).
close_reason: Merged to main as f519ffbc. Config built from MEASUREMENT, not taste: one --enable-all-rules pass produced exact counts for all 249 lint-phase rules (176,048 violations across 143 firing rules); ONLY rules measuring exactly ZERO were admitted. 84 rules enabled, 0 violations, ZERO Swift source edits, no repo-wide --fix. Key choices: only_rules (not disabled_rules) so a SwiftLint upgrade can't turn the gate red on an unchanged branch; every rule warning-severity with scripts/lint.sh getting its teeth from --strict (bare swiftlint stays advisory in Xcode, the gate is zero-tolerance); lint.sh refuses repo-wide --fix; exit 70 reserved for infrastructure vs swiftlint's exit 2 for violations; lint.sh exports DEVELOPER_DIR itself because the global xcode-select is CommandLineTools which ships no sourcekitd. The 143 declined rules are documented in-file with measured counts and tiered as a follow-up roadmap — Tier D is the high-value shortlist (variable_shadowing 144, unused_parameter 401, async_without_await 396, force_unwrapping 389, and identical_operands 3, which are probably three real defects worth a human's eyes). Verification: swiftlint exits 0 bare and --strict on a pristine archive; a probe violation makes fast-gate exit 2 in 0.34s with zero xcodebuild; focused gate green; full-gate failures all confirmed load flakes (14 tests pass in 0.672s isolated vs 60s timeouts under load).

title: Fast transcript coverage watermark remains at 60s after full-episode chunks persist
description: On the THEMOVE phone asset, fast transcript chunks cover through 3575.88s of a 3578.10s episode, but the persisted fast coverage watermark is still 60s. Consumers can therefore make scheduling, admission, completeness, or denominator decisions from stale state even though the canonical transcript is effectively complete. This coexists with the semantic scan stopping at 1425.9 and should be treated as an independent coverage-accounting defect.
acceptance_criteria: Coverage watermark advances monotonically from persisted canonical chunk coverage and reconciles on resume/finalization. A full fast transcript cannot report 60s coverage. Add migration/reconciliation for existing assets, mixed fast/final coverage tests, and an invariant comparing watermark, max covered time, and episode duration with explicit tolerated gaps.
notes:
2026-07-26 P0 review (Fable): verified still-open on main @94809607; P0 CONFIRMED and impact is sharper than filed. Watermark state feeds AnalysisCoordinator / AnalysisJobRunner / ActivitySnapshotProvider consumers, and since #285 activated the glo9 opportunistic backlog drain, the admission gate ('active episode hot-path caught up — coverage comfortably ahead of playhead') reads coverage state: a watermark stuck at 60s on an effectively-complete episode can permanently block backlog drain during playback sessions, silently nullifying glo9. During fix, verify exactly which coverage signal the glo9 admission gate reads and add a test for that path specifically.
2026-07-27 DAN: implement this bead with the iterative-implementation-with-review-loops skill (implementer subagent, then FRESH reviewer subagents that FIX what they find, until TWO CONSECUTIVE zero-finding rounds; cap 20 per this repo's convention, not the skill's default 5).

Measured costs on this box: warm no-op focused run 68s; focused run after touching a production file 85s; full gate ~5.5 min; whole battery 10 builds/~17 min.

Every round must set DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode-beta.app/Contents/Developer, never pipe a gate through a mask (a pipeline returns the LAST exit code, so a failed gate reads as 0), and never run two xcodebuild processes concurrently (16 GB box; the loser is OOM-killed with no test failure).
close_reason: Merged to main as 51a5aada. ROOT CAUSE: updateFastTranscriptCoverage was a blind UPDATE carrying the end of whichever shard finished LAST, and prioritizeShards orders behind-the-playhead shards last in DESCENDING start order — so a pass reaching the end of the episode persisted an early shard boundary, exactly 60.0s at the production 30s shard duration. GLO9 IMPACT CONFIRMED (and refined): admissionBlocksDeferred() itself reads no coverage (it is the gtt9.14 scenePhase/playbackContext matrix); the coverage signal is condition 5 of opportunisticDrainRelaxationApplies -> activeEpisodeHotPathCaughtUp(), which reads the RAW persisted column with no read-time reconciliation. Frozen at 60s, transcribedAhead is 0 for any playhead past a minute, permanently below the 120s runway, so the shipped #285 backlog drain was silently dead for that listening session — and the same stale value kept the yqax catch-up trigger firing forever on an episode with nothing left to transcribe. FIX: monotonic advance (rejecting non-finite/negative, permanent under monotonicity) + one sanctioned zero-chunk rewind; reconciliation from canonical fast-pass chunk MAX(endTime) at resume on BOTH pipelines and at finalization; schema v37 version-gated idempotent set-based migration repairing rows already on disk (without it every current dogfood asset stays broken forever). Adds FastTranscriptCoverageInvariant with explicit two-directional tolerances, deliberately silent on interior gaps (reach is not area — the sd71 antipattern). 29 new tests; lint clean; 5/14 build budget. Full-gate failures all pre-existing: 3 source-canary regressions that fail on main too (target files byte-identical to main) + documented load flakes.

title: A reverted mixed-width window must not become a whole-span negative label
description: On THEMOVE the user reverted auto window 3493.02-3536.90 because its width was wrong. Transcript/audio inspection shows the window contains show sign-off through 3498.48, silence, then a real HAIKS ad from 3505.74-3536.10, followed immediately by a Libsyn ad from 3536.40. Treating one-tap revert as whole-window false-positive feedback incorrectly labels about 30.36s of true ad as negative and can poison fingerprint/catalog learning. The same UI gesture currently cannot distinguish wrong presence from wrong leading/trailing edge.
acceptance_criteria: P0 scope (learning-attribution guard, not UX): (1) One-tap revert still restores playback immediately. (2) When a reverted window contains strong internal ad evidence (catalog/fingerprint match, lexical ad anchors, rediff overlap), learning must NOT emit a whole-span negative label — either defer attribution for disambiguation or attribute negatives only to the evidence-free subspan. (3) Catalog/fingerprint examples derived from the window are revoked/updated per-subinterval, never negated wholesale. (4) Regression: the exact sign-off+HAIKS+Libsyn fixture (revert of 3493.02-3536.90) produces no negative label over the true-ad subspan 3505.74-3536.10. OUT OF SCOPE (absorbed by parent playhead-1mq1.2, Phase 2): correction UX expressiveness — not-an-ad vs start-too-early vs end-too-late vs mixed options, and any edge-adjustment UI.
notes:
2026-07-26 P0 review (Fable): SCOPE NARROWED to the learning-attribution guard. Rationale: jw63.1 explicit-feedback capture shipped (5c1a167e) and catalog/fingerprint self-learning is live, so whole-span negative labels from one-tap reverts are poisoning training data NOW — that guard can't wait for Phase 2. The correction-UX expressiveness (distinguishing not-an-ad / edge-wrong / mixed at the gesture level) moved up to parent playhead-1mq1.2 (P1, Phase 2 Trust) where the Gate-2 mark-surfacing work already lives. P0-under-P1-parent is intentional: the child is a data-integrity bug, the parent is UX polish.
2026-07-26: now BLOCKED BY playhead-i08e — the per-show threshold-control write path is dead on the manual-'not an ad' revert seam (main is red on that test). That is the same correction-attribution plumbing this bead must harden, so fix i08e first or the learning-attribution guard lands on a write path that isn't firing.
close_reason: Merged to main as 204d617f. RevertEvidencePartition splits a reverted span into CLEAN (no internal evidence, or evidence covering it end-to-end — keeps the whole-span negative) vs MIXED (negatives attach only to substantial evidence-free remainders, and to nothing when none survive the 3s minimum). Strong evidence = URL/promoCode/disclosurePhrase catalog OCCURRENCES haloed ±8s and bridged across ≤30s gaps, plus a different live ad window overlapping the span. Deliberately NOT admitted: the reverted window's OWN window-wide provenance (claimsCatalogMatch, rediff-byte-exact edges) — that asserts the whole window is an ad, the very claim the revert contradicts, so admitting it would mark every catalog-matched revert MIXED and permanently unlearnable. ingestNegativeFingerprint DEFERS on MIXED because evidenceText carries no time index and cannot be sliced (on this fixture it IS the real ad's copy); revokeRecurrenceEvidence derives FUZZY fingerprints only from feature windows entirely inside an attributable subspan, leaving the exact source tombstone and exact matchedEntryId revocation untouched. THEMOVE regression proves no negative over 3505.74-3536.10 while a seeded catalog entry carrying the ad's fingerprint survives; two controls (clean revert, fully-evidenced revert) still bank their whole-span negative so the assertions cannot pass off a dead write path. TWO REAL BUGS CAUGHT IN REVIEW: (1) coverage-hull hazard — using coverageStartTime/EndTime brackets FIRST and LAST occurrence, so a twice-read sponsor URL spans most of the episode and pushed the evidence-free remainder INTO the real ad; now reads occurrences. (2) resolve conflated 'no usable remainder' with 'covered', so a window whose evidence left a 2.9s head remainder was called CLEAN and handed back whole, real ad included — margin against this bead's own fixture was ~4s of anchor placement, failing in the attribute-everything direction. Battery gains P01/P02, both KILLED. Budget 14/14. FLAGGED FOR DAN: trust penalty and controller sample are unchanged on MIXED (per-show scalars, not span labels) — arguably a mixed revert should not raise the show's threshold, but that is a policy call and was not made unilaterally.

title: FM refusal and guardrail failures abort coverage instead of degrading locally
description: Phone analysis persisted 19 semantic rows then stopped at 1425.9: 9 noAds, 2 containsAd, 9 refusals, and one Lagoon guardrail violation. The coarse standard-classifier refusal path has no permissive retry, and a guardrail violation aborts the remaining coarse pass, leaving the rest of the episode including postroll unscanned. In the correct-show Catalyst replay, passA found strong ad presence at intro/outro but the 1184.16-3009.84 window guardrailed twice and 1377.30-2105.52 refused; passB persisted two noAds rows with 0.0-0.0 boundaries, so no localized FM spans widened or added candidates.
acceptance_criteria: Treat refusal/guardrail as per-window outcomes and continue the scan. Retry coarse refusal through the permissive classifier with bounded context shrink. Persist valid window coordinates for passB and require a successful containsAd coarse result to create localized extent attempts. Add coverage assertions through episode end and a regression where a mid-episode guardrail cannot suppress postroll scanning. Report scanned-duration denominator accurately.
notes:
2026-07-26 P0 review (Fable): P0 CONFIRMED — this is pipeline robustness (existing scanning silently truncated), not deferred detection improvement. A mid-episode guardrail hit leaving the postroll unscanned directly feeds the #1 known gold gap (postroll slots missing in 21/35 audited episodes) and corrupts every scanned-duration denominator downstream (coverage %, precision measurement, 0sro watermark invariants). Known prior art: FM guardrail refusals abort ~40% of plans (2026-05-25 chapter-signal finding) — this bead is the productionized degrade-locally fix for that chronic failure mode. Related: playhead-0sro (denominator accuracy), playhead-2350 (missing postroll FM support on the same fixture traces to this abort).
2026-07-28 DAN DECISION on the item this bead deliberately declined: DO NOT narrow shouldRefine from 'containsAd || uncertain' to 'containsAd' only. Leave it as-is.

The implementer delivered the ENFORCEABLE half of the bead's 'require a successful containsAd coarse result before creating localized extent attempts' — only successfully-examined windows appear in coarse.windows, so a refusal or guardrail can never generate refinement work — and declined the narrow reading as a detection/recall change rather than control flow. That was the right call and the decision confirms it.

REASONING: 'uncertain' is precisely where refinement earns its keep. A window the coarse pass is confident about needs less help; a window it is unsure about is where a closer look changes the answer. Narrowing to containsAd-only would refine where we are already confident and skip where we are not, which is backwards. It is a recall change dressed as a cleanup, and it belongs to the detection-improvement class the 2026-07-24 founder reorder deferred.

The one honest argument for narrowing is FM cost — calls are expensive and this app fights for background windows. That is an argument for BUDGETING refinement, not for deleting a class of it, and qbib already added a pass budget (max(3, planCount)) that such a cap could hang off if cost ever becomes the binding constraint. Revisit as a budgeting question, never as a narrowing one.
close_reason: Merged to main as 1d263d09. The P0 fix is one conceptual change: SemanticScanStatus.failureScope asks whether a failure is a property of THIS WINDOW'S CONTENT (.window — refusal, guardrail violation, context overflow, decode failure, rate limit) or of the DEVICE/MODEL/SESSION (.pass — unavailable, unsupported locale, assets unavailable, thermal deferral, cancellation). coarsePassA/refinePassB now tolerate .window failures instead of a hardcoded list that omitted .guardrailViolation; before, ONE mid-episode guardrail returned early and every later window including the postroll was never attempted. Recovery: whole window through permissive guardrails, then two contiguous HALVES (split, not truncate — a truncated retry hides the dropped part while a split keeps it visible with its own coordinates), hard cap 3/window, pass budget max(3, planCount). Also fixed passB persisting 0.0-0.0 window coordinates (now falls back to line-ref bounds: spans describe the ad extent, the window describes where we looked). DENOMINATOR: SemanticScanCoverage splits rows on didExamineWindow into examined vs unexamined, unions overlaps, subtracts recovered ranges; the load-bearing test reproduces the phone failure (rows stopping at 1425.9s of 3578s) and asserts that WITHOUT episodeDuration the truncated run reads as COMPLETE — which is why coverage must be measured against episode end, not against the rows a run happened to write. 15 new tests verified executed-by-name via xcresulttool rather than inferred from a green suite. Self-review caught 3 real defects incl. classifyPermissively swallowing CancellationError as a refusal (a BG-window expiry would burn all 3 attempts, log 3 bogus refusals, and persist .persistFailure — never retried — instead of .cancelled). Budget 7/14; final gate's only failure is the known pre-existing y87g red.

title: Separate ad presence from extent and block auto-skip on unanchored edges
description: Exact Catalyst replay produced the same four boundaries in catalog-on/off/correct-show arms: 74.58-89.82, 1241.70-1286.94, 1326.10-1335.90, 3493.02-3537.95. Every persisted edge was unanchored yet every window had eligibilityGate=eligible; correct-show FM/catalog made all four autoSkipEligible. FM coarse scans correctly reported containsAd over huge windows (17.04-1183.62, 49.02-1376.94, 3010.44-3575.88) but fusion attached presence confidence to narrow lexical/music seeds without deriving extent. The outro seed includes 12.72s of show sign-off, one full HAIKS ad, then only 1.55s of the following Libsyn ad. Refinement is bounded near the seed and cannot recover 40-140s missing host-read extent.
acceptance_criteria: P0 scope (safety gate only): (1) Represent presence confidence separately from boundary/extent confidence in the fused verdict. (2) autoSkipEligible requires independently supported start AND end anchors (deterministic/byte/rediff-grade or corroborated); any unanchored edge -> detect-only/mark-only, per the certainty-tiered skip policy. (3) Regression on the THEMOVE Catalyst fixture: the four replayed windows (74.58-89.82, 1241.70-1286.94, 1326.10-1335.90, 3493.02-3537.95) all become mark-only — none autoSkipEligible; a window whose leading edge overlaps the 3492.36-3498.48 sign-off must never be auto-skippable. (4) Width/IoU assertions may land as measurement, not as gates. OUT OF SCOPE (moved to playhead-4xqf, deferred): host-read/ad-pod boundary inference (disclosure, return-to-show, episode-edge, silence/cut evidence) and recovery of the full intro/midroll/postroll pods on this fixture.
notes:
2026-07-26 P0 review (Fable): SCOPE NARROWED to the safety half — presence-vs-extent representation + unanchored-edge auto-skip blocking + fixture regression. Rationale: that half is a live trust bug (all four replayed windows had eligibilityGate=eligible on unanchored edges) and matches Dan's certainty-tiered-skip policy. The extent-RECOVERY half (pod boundary inference, recovering ~0.42-90.30 / ~1184.16-1426.44 / ~3505.74-3575.88) is detection improvement — per the 2026-07-24 founder reorder that class of work is deferred; the fixture evidence was appended to playhead-4xqf (deferred boundary-undersizing bug) so it isn't lost. Related: playhead-qbib (the coarse-scan abort is why the postroll region had no FM extent support on this fixture).

When a correction arrives with no usable show identity (podcastId nil or empty, or the exactFeedbackShowIdentity check otherwise fails):
- DO persist the durable CorrectionEvent receipt. A listener's correction is never silently dropped — it stays a durable record of what they said.
- DO NOT perform any SHOW-KEYED learning: no catalog/recurrence evidence, no negative-fingerprint bank ingest, no per-show threshold-controller sample, no per-show trust penalty. description: 9s6q non-monotonic segment recovery was activated day-0 MARK-ONLY (xsdz.36, 2026-07-23). comments.text:
=== FIELD EVIDENCE ARRIVES, AND WITH IT THE HONEST RISK STATEMENT (from playhead-5o7p's investigation, 2026-08-11) ===

playhead-5o7p was filed on the premise that a show-mode gate blocks byte-exact day-0 auto-skip. It does not — gard shipped that exemption on 2026-08-02 and the flag has been on since qs0d. The four day-0 windows on Dan's device are markOnly because strict == false: with accepted=1 B-side, strictByteExactMask is all-true iff the alignment was monotonicClean, it was not, so they came through YOUR arm — 9s6q segment recovery.

So the seconds this bead would unlock are now measured on a real device, on one episode of five (Conan, 'Summer S'pouses Episode 2: Amanda Lund', 1925.7s). FOUR windows, 146.97 SECONDS:

  0.00-60.26    (60.26s)  start is the EPISODE START — outer edge, free by Dan's per-edge ruling. The single inner edge is conservatively corroborated: independent acoustic detections run to 98.70, i.e. 38.4s PAST rediff's end. LOW RISK.
  888.58-915.05 (26.46s)  both edges inner. NO corroborating signal anywhere in the episode. UNKNOWN.
  942.39-987.56 (45.17s)  both edges inner, but ENCLOSES acoustic detections at 944.70-956.03 (conf 0.951) and 960.18-978.66 (conf 1.00), with 2.31s lead-in and 8.90s TRAIL. That 8.9s is the largest single exposure if the acoustic end is the truth.
  1880.35-1895.42 (15.07s) both edges inner, ends 30.28s before the episode. NO corroboration. UNKNOWN.

THE SENTENCE THIS BEAD NEEDS BEFORE IT SHIPS: I cannot say none of them clips show, and TWO of them (888.58-915.05 and 1880.35-1895.42, 41.5s combined) have NO independent signal of any kind. If any of the four eats show content, it is one of those two. There is no gold for this episode, and segment-recovered edge tightness is exactly what this bead records as unvalidated.

Also worth carrying: 27.34s of audio is RETAINED between windows 2 and 3. If that is a split pod the listener still hears it — an under-skip rather than a clip, which is the cheap direction.

WHAT THIS MAKES pyq7: no longer a theoretical promotion question. It is 'measure segment-recovered boundary tightness, then promote' — and the measurement is the blocker, not the promotion. Per Dan's ruling that a mark is worth far less than a skip but an inner edge eats the show, promoting two windows with zero corroboration is exactly the trade he has said not to make blind.

comments.author: Dan Abrams
comments.text:
=== THE MEASUREMENT, AND THE VERDICT: NO. Segment-recovered slots must NOT be promoted to auto-skip. (2026-08-11) ===

INSTRUMENT. PlayheadTests/Services/AdDetection/RediffRefetch/RediffSegmentRecoveryBoundaryMeasurementTests.swift — 31 synthetic A/B MP3 pairs with EXACT gold (the harness places the divergent bytes, so there is no oracle error), run through the real production RediffByteAligner + RediffSlotOwnership.gateAndDiffBytes on both arms. 4 tests, 1 suite, GATE_EXIT=0.

WHY SYNTHETIC. The corpus cannot answer this and it is worth saying plainly. playhead-dogfood-diagnostics-tier-a-rediff-byte.json predates 9s6q, records STRICT slots only, and its staged A/B audio is gone (TestFixtures/Corpus/Audio is a .gitkeep). scratchpad/rediff-minutes/ (the 9s6q evidence) is gone too. The segmented slot set has never been computed for a real pair except the four on Dan's device. What IS reproducible is the mechanism, because the aligner is a pure function of two byte strings.

ANSWER 1+2 — PER-EDGE SIGNED DELTA (emitted - gold), by edge class, over slots the arm emitted for a genuine divergence:
  OUTER start n=1   all +0.0000
  OUTER end   n=1   all +0.0000
  INNER start n=12  p50 +0.0002  p95 +0.0003  max +0.0003
  INNER end   n=12  p50 -0.0000  p95 +0.0000  max +0.0000
Sub-millisecond, and the sign is always the SAFE direction (start late, end early) — the residual is the 4-byte shared CBR frame header the earlier run's greedy extension carries across the splice: 4/417 of a 26 ms frame. On a genuine divergence a segment-recovered edge is as tight as a strict one. That half of the question is an unqualified pass.

ANSWER 3 — THE TAIL, AND IT IS NOT AN EDGE PROBLEM. 24 inner edges; ONE ate show, and it ate 299.99 s. The risk is not drift, it is a WHOLE-BLOCK false positive:
  * 7 of the 20 emitted slots contain ZERO gold ad seconds. Widths 120.01 / 240.01 / 240.01 / 299.99 / 359.99 / 420.00 / 469.99 s. 100% show, every one.
  * The only guard is maxSlotSeconds (480 s). Measured boundary: tails of 120/240/360/420/470 s ACCEPT; 540/720 s reject. Widest shippable pure-show phantom: 469.99 s.
  * Worst shape (D/inserted+removed): ONE slot 299.9905..629.9690 carrying a real 30 s ad AND 299.99 s of show — an inner start edge 300 s early, indistinguishable at the mint from the exact ones.
Mechanism: RediffByteAligner.swift:693 drops any run that A-overlaps an already-accepted one, then reports its A-span as divergent. The 4-byte header bleed creates exactly that overlap whenever the FRESH copy has a break the PLAYED copy lacks. Filed as playhead-3zxd (P1, blocks this bead).

WHICH STRUCTURES EVEN REACH THIS ARM. Measured: a pure ROTATION chains monotonically at every length ratio (30/30, 60/30, 30/60, x1-x3) — 9s6q is a no-op there. Only a break-COUNT disagreement goes non-monotonic. So the recovery arm's entire input population is the population in which the phantom lives; removed-in-B is the exact half, inserted-in-B the phantom half.

WHY 0.50 s / 0.75 s OF PADDING CANNOT COVER THIS. AutoSkipEdgePadding's rediffByteExact margins were derived from the xsdz.44 spike's 11 gold breaks on MONOTONIC-CLEAN chains (|dEnd| median 0.02 s). Promotion would stamp .rediffByteExact on both edges of a recovered slot, which also trips the qs0d TARGETED activation (isActive returns true with the Gate-2 master switch still off). A 470 s phantom would skip 468.75 s of show. No margin sized in tenths of a second can cover an error sized in minutes — they are different failure classes, and this is the qs0d derivation being applied to a population it was not derived on.

ANSWER 4 — CORROBORATION. Device: 2 of 4 windows have no overlapping detection of any kind (888.58-915.05 and 1880.35-1895.42). I could not widen n: only 2 of ~50 db snapshots on this box carry day-0 rows and both are the same asset. But corroboration cannot be the precondition anyway — RediffRefetchService.swift:653 mints immediately after the download, before any transcription or acoustic pass, so no other signal exists at mint time. Requiring one would defer the mark and defeat day-0.
One thing the measurement DOES say about those two: the phantom's width is the distance from the dropped run to the next accepted one, i.e. an inter-break content block (minutes). At 26.46 s and 15.07 s neither uncorroborated device window has the shape of this defect. That is a partial acquittal, not a clearance — no gold exists for that episode.

WHAT WOULD MAKE THEM SAFE (measured, gold-free, available at mint time). For each emitted segmented slot, the A-seconds covered by any FOUND run must be zero. Over 20 slots this quantity NEVER under-reported eaten show (0 misses) and equalled it exactly on all 7 phantoms: total eaten 2450.00 s, total aligned-inside 2450.00 s. It needs no gold and no other detector, so it works on real audio on the day-0 path. That is playhead-3zxd. Once it holds, this bead's measurement can be re-run and the promotion re-decided on the exact-edge numbers above, which are already skip-grade.

MUTATION EVIDENCE the rails are not vacuous (SHA-256-pinned restore, verified OK after each):
  M1 segmented start edge -4096 bytes            -> GATE_EXIT=65 (families A, C)
  M2 maxSlotSeconds 480 -> 600                   -> GATE_EXIT=65 (family B only — the cap boundary is pinned to the value)
  M3 greedy accept keeps A-overlapping runs      -> GATE_EXIT=65 (families A, B, D — the phantom rails pin the mechanism, not a number)

RESIDUAL RISKS. (a) Synthetic CBR pairs: real VBR or cross-encoder stitches may bleed 0 bytes instead of 4, which changes how OFTEN the overlap occurs but not what happens when it does. (b) The sweep found no non-monotonic cause other than break-count disagreement; real audio may have others (duplicate creatives, mid-file ID3, coincidental long extensions) and those were not measured. (c) n=4 on one episode remains the only field data. The capture that would close all three: stage A/B pairs for the 8 non-monotonic corpus episodes and record runsFound, segmentedRunsChained, and per-run A/B spans — the per-run spans are what the aligned-seconds test needs and nothing on disk has ever recorded them.

title: Listeners stop reaching for +30s: auto-skip byte-certain ads (rediff mark-only → skip)
description:
Day-0 rediff was ACTIVATED mark-only (xsdz.36, 2026-07-23: dayZeroEnabledByDefault + nonMonotonicSegmentRecoveryEnabled flipped true). Byte-exact rediff divergence is 100% deterministic — the highest-certainty DAI signal — so per the certainty-tiered skip policy it should AUTO-SKIP, not just banner (Dan 2026-07-23: 'if these are deterministic, skip seems the preferred method'). Chosen path = option A: ship mark-only first, promote to skip after dogfood confirms the byte-exact banners land on real ads with clean boundaries. This bead is that promotion for the STRICT (monotonic-clean) byte-exact slots. WORK: (1) set eligibilityGate=.eligible on byte-exact rediff-certain spans (day-0 mint + lagged sweep) — mirroring how playhead-527u made user marks eligible; (2) BYPASS the FM eligibility gate for these spans — deterministic byte-exact slots self-certify and must NOT route through the non-deterministic FM pass that historically forced mark-only (the FM-coin-flip blocker); (3) apply 98co asymmetric start-edge padding so the skip is late-safe (never clips editorial). SCOPE: STRICT monotonic-clean slots only; keep 9s6q segment-recovered (non-monotonic) slots as BANNER until separately validated.
## NEW BLOCKER FOUND 2026-07-31 — day-0 rediff spans land `unanchored`

Dan 2026-07-31: "let's turn on rediff for the next build."

Measured on his clean install, episode DE0784D8. The two byte-exact day-0 windows:

    0.0    - 60.1   s   conf 1.00  dayZeroRediffByteExact  startAnchor=unanchored  endAnchor=unanchored
    5462.6 - 5522.7 s   conf 1.00  dayZeroRediffByteExact  startAnchor=unanchored  endAnchor=unanchored

**They carry the same `unanchored` pair as the 0.40-confidence aggregator windows that skipped
210 s of show the same afternoon.** So the 2350 gate holds them at markOnly — correctly, given
what it can see. The boundary is in fact the most precise in the system (byte divergence IS the
DAI splice, ~1 s), but nothing records that.

`AutoSkipEdgeAnchor` HAS the right case (`rediffByteExact`, AutoSkipEdgePadding.swift:70,
documented "byte-verified splice mapped to the A timeline") and `SpanExtentSupport.derive`
(:149) sets it from `anchorProvenance.contains(.rediffSlot)`. So the machinery exists; the
day-0 mint path evidently does not put `.rediffSlot` into anchorProvenance, or does not route
through derive at all. **`unanchored` here means "no anchor was recorded", not "the boundary is
unknown"** — the recurring defect shape again, see
[[feedback_ask_what_the_quantity_measures_2026-07-29]].

### Consequence for the requested flip

Flipping `AutoSkipEdgePadding.isEnabledByDefault` (AutoSkipEdgePadding.swift:118, currently
false, "held behind Gate 2... flip deliberately, with the Gate-2 blocker set — wraj surfacing +
veto masks + 3-run reproducibility — green") would achieve NOTHING on its own: with both edges
unanchored the padding policy yields no late-safe window and the span stays markOnly.

Ordered work to actually deliver the flip:

  1. **Anchor plumbing (NEW, and a correctness fix regardless of auto-skip):** the day-0 mint
     and lagged-sweep paths must record `.rediffSlot` width ownership so `derive` yields
     `.rediffByteExact`. Until this lands, every downstream step is inert. Do this FIRST and
     verify on device that persisted rows stop reading `unanchored`.
  2. Items (1) and (2) already in this bead: eligibilityGate=.eligible on strict
     monotonic-clean byte-exact spans; bypass the FM eligibility gate (deterministic slots
     self-certify).
  3. [[playhead-98co]] asymmetric late-safe start padding, so the skip never clips editorial.
  4. Master enable, with the Gate-2 preconditions honoured. [[playhead-wraj]] is the
     certainty-tiered gate this belongs to and is IN_PROGRESS.

### Field evidence supporting the promotion (2026-07-31)

Same episode, same afternoon:

BLOCKER CLEARED. The day-0 mint (mintByteExactDayZeroMarks) built its AdWindow directly and never routed through SpanExtentSupport.derive, so startEdgeAnchor/endEdgeAnchor took their .unanchored defaults. The LAGGED sweep was already correct (.rediffSlot -> derive -> persisted columns) — only day-0 was missing. CORRECTION TO THE BEAD's ANALYSIS — the master switch's polarity is inverted from how the bead reads. AutoSkipEdgePadding.isEnabledByDefault=false does NOT mean 'nothing auto-skips'; SkipOrchestrator.paddedCueSpan short-circuits to the RAW snapped span when it is off, so every .eligible span skips unpadded. Flag ON is strictly MORE conservative: padding only shrinks or suppresses, and it returns nil for an unanchored start. A global flip would therefore SUPPRESS auto-skip for the unanchored aggregator population that ate the 210 s — it would not widen anything. Pre-existing (mark-only banners had the same latency) but it directly limits whether the next dogfood pass will SHOW a rediff auto-skip in the session that minted it.

title: HYPER-CRITICAL: played/analyzed audio artifact rotates (DAI stitch replaced under the user) — pin one immutable audio per episode
description:
## HYPER-CRITICAL (Dan 2026-07-22): the played/analyzed audio artifact ROTATES

### Symptom (dogfood, THEMOVE, a DAI show)
User played an episode and marked ads. WITHOUT deleting or re-downloading, the AUDIO ITSELF rotated — "the ads in the audio were different, somehow the audio rotated." This cascades into every symptom the user saw:
- marks appear undone (time-based marks on stitch A land on different content in the rotated stitch B),
- "different ads on the second marking" (genuinely different creatives — different DAI stitch),
- unstable detection run-to-run (analyzing different audio).

### Log evidence (on-device asset-lifecycle-log) — smoking gun
`episodeDurationSec` is UNSTABLE for the SAME asset and even SHRINKS, which is impossible for a fixed local file:
- 347B688D (likely the THEMOVE ep): 1080 -> 4590 s
- B994F346: 1541 -> 690 -> 528 s (SHRANK), terminalReason "full coverage: transcript 2.158, feature 5.110" (coverage ratio > 1 => coverage exceeds recorded duration)
- 2CFD65CB: 720 -> 528 s
A shrinking duration / ratio>1 means the enclosure was RE-FETCHED and a different-length DAI stitch replaced the audio.

### Reframe / why hyper-critical
The bytes PLAYED, the bytes ANALYZED (features/transcript), and the timeline the user MARKS against are NOT guaranteed to be the same audio artifact. On a DAI show the enclosure serves a different stitch per fetch, so any path that re-fetches the played episode's audio silently rotates it out from under the user. This breaks marking, detection stability, and trust — and it undermines the entire ad-detect-and-skip premise (you can't skip an ad at time T if the audio at T changed). Note: rediff INTENDS a separate never-played copy; if a NON-rediff path is rotating the PLAYED audio, that is the bug.

### Fix direction (mechanism under investigation)
PIN one immutable audio artifact per episode: download once; play, analyze, and mark against THAT exact file; never silently re-fetch/replace it; any rediff/second-fetch stays a separate never-played copy. Make episodeDurationSec come from the decoded pinned file, not mutable feed metadata. Exact re-fetch path (background feed-refresh re-download / analysis-pipeline enclosure fetch / final-pass re-fetch / progressive-streaming DAI) is being pinned down now; fix sites to follow.

### Related
Upstream of playhead-527u (user-mark pinning is moot if the audio rotates) and the run-to-run nondeterminism playhead-1wr9. Fix this FIRST.
acceptance_criteria: The audio bytes played == analyzed == marked-against are guaranteed the SAME immutable artifact for the life of a downloaded episode; no non-rediff path re-fetches/replaces the played audio; episodeDurationSec derives from the decoded pinned file (never shrinks, ratio never >1); a regression test proves a feed-refresh / re-analysis cannot swap a downloaded episode's local audio; rediff second-fetch remains a separate never-played copy.
notes: ROOT CAUSE (investigated 2026-07-22): played audio is NOT a pinned immutable artifact. It lives at completeFileURL(for:) = completeDir/SHA256(episodeId).ext (DownloadManager.swift:1404-1418), served by EXISTENCE ONLY with no content/length/fingerprint check (cachedFileURL:1448). Playback + duration probe + features + final-pass all read that same MUTABLE path (PlayheadRuntime.swift:3005/3062/3072/3127; AnalysisWorkScheduler.swift:848; FinalPassRetranscriptionRunner.swift:744). The origin re-cuts a different DAI stitch per request (proven by RediffRefetchPolicy.isRotated). ROTATION VECTORS into the PLAYED file: (1) force-quit/interrupted RESUME via downloadTask(withResumeData:) (ForceQuitResumeScan) -> Range/If-Range splices a different stitch via handleBackgroundDownloadComplete's unconditional overwrite (DownloadManager.swift:1720-1723) — BEST matches 'rotated without re-download'; (2) LRU eviction of the unprotected file (protectForAnalysis/unprotectFromAnalysis DEFINED BUT NEVER CALLED, so analysisProtectedEpisodes always empty; evictIfNeeded:1566/1594) + transparent re-stream from episode.audioURL next play; (3) feed refresh silently overwriting ep.audioURL+ep.duration every refresh (PodcastDiscoveryService.swift:289-293) + backgroundDownload (BackgroundFeedRefreshService:993). Rediff B-side is correctly isolated (deleted-on-every-exit temp; NOT the culprit). Downstream signature = shrinking episodeDurationSec + ratio>1 (2.158/5.110): AudioFileDurationProbe re-reads the rotated SHORTER file and overwrites the longer persisted duration while transcript/feature coverage reflect the original LONGER stitch (classifyBackfillTerminal:2254-2256). FIX SITES: (1) pin episode.cachedAudioURL after first COMPLETE download + resolve playback+analysis ONLY through it (write site MISSING; PlayheadRuntime.swift:3003; Podcast.swift:191); (2) cachedFileURL/streamingDownload validate completeness + refuse in-place overwrite of a complete pinned file (DownloadManager.swift:1136-1160,1448,1720-1723,1057-1060); (3) feed refresh must not mutate a pinned episode (PodcastDiscoveryService.swift:289-293; BackgroundFeedRefreshService:993); (4) wire protectForAnalysis into eviction (DownloadManager.swift:1532/1594); (5) validate ETag/Content-Length before resume, else re-download fresh (ForceQuitResumeScan withResumeData); (6) episodeDurationSec from decoded pinned file only, drop RSS denominator (PlayheadApp.swift:630).

title: main does not compile in Release config — ungated #if DEBUG fetchAllAssets caller (latent ~2.5mo, blocks TestFlight/archive)

Root cause: AnalysisStore.fetchAllAssets() is defined ONLY inside #if DEBUG (AnalysisStore.swift:5861; doc-comment: 'not safe for production callers'), but its caller runFinalPassBackfillForAllAssetsAtLaunch (PlayheadRuntime.swift:2646, call :2656) is NOT #if DEBUG-guarded (net #if depth 0 at :2656).

Determine which from the caller's intent.

title: Download & analyze an episode on demand — without playing it (proactive pre-analysis trigger)
description: Dan 2026-07-21. A user-initiated 'Download & Analyze' action per episode that fetches the audio + runs the full pipeline (transcription + ad-detection + specialist scan) WITHOUT the user playing it — so the episode is ready with ad marks/banners BEFORE first listen. Today analysis runs on a background auto-schedule; this is an explicit trigger for proactive/ahead-of-time analysis (peace-of-mind: pre-mark the episodes you plan to hear). Wires a player/episode-list UI action into the EXISTING preAnalysis + backfill pipeline (enqueue at user-intent priority; gate on wifi/charging as today). Bonus: enables the pre-fetch path for immediate/day-0 rediff (xsdz.36.4) - analyze ahead -> marks ready at play time. Product feature; complements the value prop.
notes:
PROMOTED P2->P1 2026-07-22 on dogfood stall evidence. Dan's 4 episodes stranded at analysisState=backfill for 8h+ overnight DESPITE charging+WiFi — because iOS granted ~0 discretionary analysis.backfill BGProcessingTask windows (only one brief window overnight, spent on the lighter preanalysis.recovery). Root cause: the device was never idle (an SSH client stayed active all night), and BGProcessingTask dispatch requires device idle. CONFIRMED not a code bug: not pmp9 (FM off), not y5mk (backfill sets no earliestBeginDate so resubmit can't self-starve), not a completion bug (classifyBackfillTerminal always terminates). Foreground analysis PROVEN healthy live (playing an episode produced 257 fresh classifier decisions in minutes). So the ONLY coverage gap is episodes the user never plays: they depend entirely on iOS granting an idle background window, which ANY other device activity starves. 3xtw closes this by making deep analysis a FOREGROUND, user-intent-triggered action (enqueue at user priority, run in-app) instead of hostage to discretionary BGProcessingTask. This makes 3xtw the reliability fix for un-played-episode coverage, not just a proactive nicety. Evidence: coreai-spike/dogfood-pull/2026-07-22-* (bg-task-log 0 backfill starts since 19:40Z; decision-log 257 fresh decisions on playback). Complements [[project_pipeline_boundary_undersizing]] coverage program.
Priority raised again P1->P0 by Dan 2026-07-22: this is the reliability fix for the un-played-episode coverage gap the overnight stall exposed — treat as top-of-queue for the next build session.

title: FM background backfill fails on rate-limiting (streaming) — ad-detection coverage never completes past pre-analysis
description:
Dogfood 2026-07-21 (THEMOVE TdF stage 16, 57.8min): the fullEpisodeScan FM backfill FAILED with 'Request has been rate limited. Please try again later. If you are using streaming responses in a background request, consider using non-streaming requests in background activities to reduce the likelihood of rate limiting.' SYSTEMATIC: 5 of the device's backfill jobs failed with this exact error (backfill_jobs status=failed x5). RESULT: on a 58-min episode, ad-detection only ever covered the ~90s pre-analysis window (fmPassCount=0, 0 semantic scans past t=90, only 2 auto-skip decisions). This is the #1 CAUSE of Dan's THEMOVE detection gaps - post-roll DAI + both mid host-reads were NEVER SCANNED, not detection-quality misses. Transcription completed fine (full transcript 3475 chunks); the DETECTION backfill is what died.

ROOT: Apple FoundationModels rate-limits STREAMING requests made from a BGTask (background execution). The FM fullEpisodeScan uses streaming FM calls in the background BGProcessingTask.

FIX (per Apple's own error guidance): (1) use NON-STREAMING FM requests in background activities (respond vs streaming respond); (2) rate-limit-aware BACKOFF + resumable retry so a throttled job re-runs from progressCursor rather than failing terminally + leaving a stranded queued sibling; (3) consider chunking within the OS budget. Relates to gy2s (dispatch/liveness) + pd0q (a job that perpetually fails rate-limiting without valid progress violates pd0q Invariant 3).

KEY: the FM-FREE specialist (CoreAISequentialEngine, NOT FoundationModels) does NOT hit this FM rate limit. VERIFY the specialistHostReadScan phase runs independently of a failed fullEpisodeScan so the specialist provides host-read coverage even when the FM scan is throttled - if the specialist append is gated behind FM-scan success, decouple it. This makes the FM-free specialist doubly valuable: it sidesteps the exact rate limit killing FM coverage.

title: One banner, whole break: ads #2 and #3 don't play after we caught #1 (pod completeness)
description:
Gap-analysis 2026-07-21: pre-roll/mid DAI detection catches ad #1 of a multi-ad pod but misses the 2nd/3rd (dominant gold-undercount mode - Conan cross-promo pairs, Nikki Smile-Tunes pods). DISTINCT from 4xqf (single-span undersizing) - this is missing pod NEIGHBORS. Detector: keep detecting until content resumes so the whole pod width is covered. Generalizes structurally (detect-until-content-resumes) = most show-agnostic DAI lever. Blocks pre-roll 99pct-detection target. Needs xdh7 to measure (pods are exactly what gold under-labels).
=== MEASURED 2026-07-30 — THE "NEEDS xdh7 TO MEASURE" BLOCKER IS STALE. THIS BEAD IS NOW QUANTIFIED. ===

The bead says "Needs xdh7 to measure (pods are exactly what gold under-labels)". That was true of GOLD, but it is no longer the only ground truth available: REDIFF SLOTS ARE DAI POD BOUNDARIES, byte-derived and independent of any human labelling, so they measure pod completeness directly. Re-ran against the two files playhead-4xqf cites, both still present in the repo. No new capture, no xdh7 needed.

METHOD: for every rediff-confirmed slot the pipeline detected AT ALL, count the distinct pipeline windows landing inside it, and measure the LARGEST CONTIGUOUS UNCOVERED RUN inside the slot. A long uncovered run inside a slot the pipeline already found is, by definition, an ad it did not catch next to one it did.

RESULTS (17 detected slots, from 44 total across 9 episodes):

  distinct pipeline windows inside one true slot:
      1 window  -> 14 slots
      2 windows ->  3 slots

  of the 14 single-window slots:
      mean coverage of the slot                         0.29
      mean LARGEST uncovered run inside the slot         71 s
      slots with an uncovered run > 30 s                12 of 14

  across all 17 detected slots:
      slots with an uncovered run > 30 s                13
      total audio sitting in those runs                994 s
      largest single uncovered run                     175 s

INTERPRETATION. The pipeline lands ONE window in a pod and leaves an average 71-second hole beside it. 12 of 14 single-window slots have an uncovered run longer than 30 s — enough room for an entire additional ad, which is precisely this bead's thesis. 994 seconds of ad audio sits inside slots we ALREADY FOUND. That is separate from, and additional to, the 1,983 s lost to slots missed entirely.

THIS ALSO SETTLES THE 4xqf BOUNDARY, which both beads assert but neither had evidence for. The distinction is now operational rather than conceptual:
  * an uncovered run > ~30 s inside a detected slot = A MISSING POD NEIGHBOUR (this bead)
  * an uncovered run < ~30 s at a slot edge = SINGLE-SPAN UNDERSIZING (playhead-4xqf)
A 175-second uncovered run cannot be explained as an edge that stopped short. Use this split as the acceptance metric: the number to move is "slots with an uncovered run > 30 s", currently 13 of 17.

WHY THIS IS THE MOST SHOW-AGNOSTIC LEVER, restated with the numbers behind it: the fix shape in the original bead — keep detecting until content resumes — needs no per-show bank, no lexical anchor, and no gold. It is a structural continuation rule. And it operates on slots the pipeline has ALREADY located, so unlike the reach work it does not depend on scanning more audio.

SEQUENCING NOTE, so nobody mis-reads the priority. Reach still dominates arithmetically: 1,983 s lost to slots missed entirely (51% of all ad audio) versus 994 s inside detected slots (26%). playhead-hvk0 is the larger number. But Dan chose this bead next on 2026-07-30 for a deliberate reason — it is the closest thing on the board to what he actually experiences, having heard ad #2 play after ad #1 was caught. The felt experience and the arithmetic diverge here, and he made that trade knowingly.

CAVEAT, stated rather than buried: 17 detected slots is a small sample, and this is the Catalyst corpus dump of 2026-07-16, not Dan's device. It pre-dates every merge from 07-29/30. Trust the SHAPE (one window per pod, large holes beside it) rather than the exact figures, and re-measure on a fresh device pull before crediting any improvement.
notes:
=== ADVERSARIAL REVIEW ROUND (2026-07-30, same branch). SIX DEFECTS, ALL FIXED. ===

The most important one, because it is the failure mode this repo keeps re-learning: I MEASURED A CONFIGURATION PRODUCTION DOES NOT RUN. `rhetoricalLinks` was in every eval arm and in NO production call site, so the reported "13 -> 12" described a strict superset of the shipped link set. On the held-out device lane the LEXICAL source alone recovers NOTHING — every mark comes from the grammar — so the shipped pass would have fired on approximately nothing while the eval reported a win. Step 18b now composes both sources, and the eval ASSERTS the shipping arm matches the production configuration field by field. Numbers unchanged: 13 -> 12, 1324 -> 1195 s, 129 s claimed, 0.0 s outside any rediff slot.

Also fixed:
* The out-of-slot figure — the file's own "number that actually decides whether this ships" — was PRINTED, never asserted. A change claiming minutes of out-of-slot audio would have passed green. Now a frozen budget of zero.
* AN ACCEPTED BANNER WAS RE-CLAIMED. Accepting a suggest banner mints a `userConfirmedSuggested` row that INHERITS this pass's detectorVersion; the version-only self-exclusion treated it as ours and dropped it from the coverage set, and the `userMarked`-only protected-region filter left it unwalled. Next backfill re-claimed audio the listener had already resolved and re-minted the suppressed original. `isOwnRow` now tests BOTH provenance fields; the wire-in protects every user-owned boundary state.
* THE BEST SEED WAS REFUSED. `isSeed` reused `reconcileProtectedBoundaryStates`, which contains `dayZeroRediffByteExact` — not a user row but the byte-exact rediff pod boundary, the highest-certainty ad window we produce and the most obviously correct seed for a pod walk. Replaced with an explicit `userOwnedBoundaryStates`.
* A CONTINUATION MARK SILENTLY KILLED CROSS-USER SHARING FOR THE WHOLE ASSET. `hasKnownExportDisposition` is all-or-nothing: one unrecognized `candidate` boundaryState aborts the snapshot with no log and no error. Added `podContinuation` to the local-only set — AND `specialistScan`, which has the IDENTICAL latent defect (playhead-b6jq PR5). Both producers ship flag-off, which is the only reason it has never bitten; worth knowing before b6jq flips on.
* TWO BACKWARD-WALK BOUNDS WERE UNPINNED, with surviving mutations demonstrated: tripling the backward gap, and measuring the backward extension per-step instead of cumulatively (unbounded blast radius). Mirror tests added.
* The wire-in's protectedRegions read had NO test that could fail — an overlap-only assertion passes with `protectedRegions: []` because the residue subtraction removes the mark either way. Replaced with a two-arm contrast.

AND ONE HONESTY CORRECTION IN THE DOC. The header claimed "an absence is never an input". That is true of the walk's termination but FALSE of the bridge: the seconds between two links carry no evidence of their own and are claimed because they are bracketed and unwalled. That is BOUNDED EXTRAPOLATION, and `maxLinkGapSeconds` is its only control — which is exactly why the held-out THEMOVE trivia segment was claimable at 60 s. The header says so now.

FINAL STATE: 60 hermetic + wire-in tests plus two measurement lanes, all green. Full gate: 21 failures, all in the known load-sensitive families (playhead-voez), every one 115-176 s (CPU starvation); a real failure lands in ~2 s. Ad-detection, fusion, specialist, and cross-user-sharing suites all pass.

title: General pipeline-STALL regression test: assert the drain/liveness invariant (no eligible queued job stays undispatched with idle capacity; BGTasks make progress or defer validly; epoch-bump/restart doesn't orphan jobs)
description: Recurring class (Dan: 'this isnt the first time weve had stalls'). Build a GENERAL regression harness that catches pipeline stalls, driven by the 2026-07-20 dogfood evidence (see the stall bug bead + coreai-spike/dogfood-pull/analysis-dogfood-2026-07-20.sqlite). Core INVARIANTS to assert: (1) DRAIN/liveness — given queued+eligible analysis_jobs and free scheduler capacity, every eligible job is dispatched/advanced within a bounded deadline; no job stays queued+eligible with 0 live leases while the scheduler is idle (the exact stall signature). (2) EPOCH survival — after a schedulerEpoch bump / scheduler restart, previously-queued jobs remain dispatchable (AnalysisJobReconciler re-adopts <currentEpoch); fresh enqueues get the current epoch, not stale default 0. (3) BACKGROUND progress — a BGTask run either makes progress (jobsCompleted>0 / coverage advances) or defers for a valid reason; it must NOT perpetually outcome=expired/task_expired with 0 completions (needs resumable/chunked work within the OS time budget). (4) RECOVERY visibility — preanalysis_recovery must SEE eligible queued preAnalysis jobs (dogfood showed jobsSeen=0 while 4 were queued+eligible). Test at the integration level (scheduler + store + BGTask harness + job runner), driven deterministically (event-driven, no wall-clock per the de-flake precedent). Depends-on the root-cause investigation.

title: Music-bed discrimination upgrade: replace saturating tonalness with pause-fraction + fine-spectral-flux features (AUC 0.991) in acousticMusicProbability
notes:
TOP PRIORITY (Dan, 2026-07-17). ROOT-CAUSE FIX for music-bed detection. The pipeline acousticMusicProbability (FeatureSignalExtraction, formula tonalness*0.55 + stability*0.30 + energy*0.15) does NOT discriminate music from speech: its spectral-flatness->tonalness SATURATES near 1.0 on all podcast audio (measured content pmusic 0.739 vs ad 0.776 = useless overlap). The music-offset spike (t1py) found the REAL separators: PAUSE-FRACTION (fraction of low-energy/silent frames) + FINE SPECTRAL-FLUX ("subflux") — music-playout 0.018 pausefrac / 0.201 subflux vs host-speech 0.270 / 0.375. Composite window-level discriminator AUC = 0.991 (subflux alone 0.985) vs the current formula ~chance. FIX: add pause-fraction + fine-spectral-flux to the music-probability feature set (augment or replace the tonalness term); this improves EVERYTHING downstream that reads .musicBed / musicProbability - MusicBedLedgerEvaluator presence, the boundary-refiner bedSustainMusicProbThreshold, and the sustained-music-offset PROPOSER (t1py). Reference impl: scratchpad/musicoffset/features.py (Welch spectra, 1s/0.5s hop, pause-fraction + subflux). Validated on 28 audit episodes + 6 controls: 0 false triggers on music-under-speech (speech pauses/flux break the predicate where flatness could not). ENABLER for t1py (the proposer depends on a discriminating music-prob).
IMPLEMENTATION PLAN (scoped 2026-07-18). SITE: FeatureExtraction.swift:302 `acousticMusicProbability(magnitudes:rms:spectralFlux:)` (formula at :320) + call site :810 in the per-window extraction loop (:788). CHANGE SHAPE (additive, no arch restructure): the raw `windowSamples` are already in hand at :789, so compute 3 sub-frame features per window and feed them in: pauseFraction (frac of ~64ms sub-frames with RMS<0.03), subflux (mean fine spectral-flux between consecutive sub-frame mag-spectra), rmscov (CoV of sub-frame RMS). Then replace the saturating formula with the VALIDATED composite from reference detector.py music_prob(): tonal_z=clip((tonal-0.88)/0.12); quiet=1-clip(pausefrac/0.30); lowflux=clip((0.42-subflux)/0.14); steady=1-clip(rmscov/1.0); loud=clip((rms-0.02)/0.06); mp = 0.28*quiet + 0.30*lowflux + 0.20*tonal_z + 0.12*steady + 0.10*loud. Reference: scratchpad/musicoffset/features.py (sub-frame extractor) + detector.py (composite).
*** THE ONE REAL DECISION (calibration): Swift analysis window = 2.0s NON-OVERLAPPING (FeatureExtractionConfig default :50, windowDuration 2.0 / overlapFraction 0.0). The reference AUC-0.991 discrimination + all thresholds were calibrated at 1.0s frame / 0.5s hop. pausefrac/subflux/rmscov are ratio/mean features that are largely scale-stable 1s->2s (music playout ~0 pauses either way), so the port is EXPECTED to transfer, but the exact thresholds (0.30/0.42/0.88) may want a light retune at 2s. Options: (A-recommended) port thresholds as-is + gate the loop on an empirical validation that the new formula separates music-playout from speech on real fixtures BETTER than the old (which measured 0.739 vs 0.776 = chance); if it does not clearly separate, retune. (B) pre-recalibrate at 2s against the audit episodes before porting. CONSUMER BLAST RADIUS to keep green: MusicBedLedgerEvaluator presence, boundary-refiner bedSustainMusicProbThreshold(0.25)/bedSustainMusicProb, MusicBedClassifier.classify(:829), and t1py (depends on this discriminating output). musicProbability(:220) takes max(acoustic, SoundAnalysis-timeline) so a better acoustic prob strictly helps. READY TO IMPLEMENT via review-loop pending Dan OK on calibration option A vs B.
CALIBRATION DECISION: Dan chose OPTION B (2026-07-18) — pre-recalibrate the composite at the 2.0s Swift window BEFORE porting to Swift. Recalibration agent launched: recompute the sub-frame features (pausefrac/subflux/rmscov/tonalness) at 2.0s NON-overlapping frames from the 34 corpus mp3s, reconstruct music-playout(pos) vs speech+music-under-speech(neg) window labels grounded in the validated 1s runs + audit post-rolls + the music-heavy controls (99pi/on-the-media/night-vale) as hard negatives, measure ROC-AUC OLD-formula vs NEW-composite at 2s, sweep/retune the internal cutpoints (tonal-0.88, pausefrac/0.30, subflux 0.42/0.14) + is_music_window predicate, emit recalibrated 2s values + a GO_PORT_AS_IS / RETUNE / NO_GO verdict. Deliverables: scratchpad/musicoffset/recalib_2s.json + recalib_2s_report.md. Reference 1s numbers to beat: musicProb_AUC 0.991, playout musicProb 0.915 vs speech 0.439. Swift port (review-loop) starts once the 2s thresholds + verdict are in hand.
RECALIBRATION VERDICT (2026-07-18): GO_PORT_AS_IS. The composite survives 1.0s->2.0s non-overlapping essentially unchanged: composite AUC @2s = 0.997 (0.998 full pop) vs 0.991 @1s (marginally CLEANER at 2s - longer frame averages out speech micro-gaps). Retuning internal cutpoints on 2s features buys only +0.001 -> KEEP the 1s weights + cutpoints AS-IS. OLD formula @2s = 0.576 (chance): POS 0.738 vs NEG 0.722 identical, false-fires on music-under-speech (0.589 vs composite 1.000). Supporting @2s: subflux-alone 0.988, pausefrac-alone 0.932. Feature means reproduce 1s ref (POS/NEG pausefrac 0.016/0.208, subflux 0.215/0.385, musicProb 0.909/0.439). Labels: POS 229 (140 in confirmed playout-to-ad runs), NEG 916 (458 speech + 458 music-under-speech hard negatives). PORT SPEC (confirmed): compute per-2s-window from raw windowSamples the 3 sub-frame features (1024-sample Hann sub-FFTs @512 hop): pauseFraction (frac subframes RMS<0.03), subflux (mean norm-L1/2 flux between consecutive subframe spectra), rmsCoV (std/mean subframe RMS); composite = 0.28*quiet + 0.30*lowflux + 0.20*tonal_z + 0.12*steady + 0.10*loud with quiet=1-clip(pausefrac/0.30), lowflux=clip((0.42-subflux)/0.14), tonal_z=clip((tonalness-0.88)/0.12), steady=1-clip(rmsCoV/1.0), loud=clip((rms-0.02)/0.06). Skip threshold on composite = 0.76 (Youden J=0.95, TPR 0.96/FPR 0.012) - but thats a t1py/consumer knob, NOT part of riiz. OPTIONAL (t1py only, not riiz): tighten is_music_window predicate to PF<=0.20/SF<=0.330/TON<=0.945/RMS>=0.035 (F1 0.921->0.953). Deliverables: scratchpad/musicoffset/recalib_2s.json + recalib_2s_report.md + features2s.py/extract2s.py/measure2s.py. CLEARED TO PORT via review-loop.

title: Sustained-music-offset boundary PROPOSER: detect long (>=8-10s) music run, propose a candidate boundary at its trailing music->speech edge (doac post-roll play-out)
notes:
FINDING (2026-07-17 subagent). doac post-roll (NetSuite) is preceded by a long (15-27s) sustained tonal play-out music swell -> ad-speech, transition SHARP (silence-gap/flatness jump) within ~0.3-1.5s of gold. KEY ARCHITECTURAL INSIGHT: the music-bed path REFINES but does not PROPOSE. MusicBedLedgerEvaluator (AdDetectionService ~6838) is span-scoped PRESENCE evidence (adds weight to an EXISTING span); the music->ad OFFSET is reachable via BracketDetector(0.3)/TimeBoundaryResolver(bedSustainMusicProbThreshold=0.25) but those are boundary-REFINEMENT (snap existing candidate), NOTHING proposes the post-roll span. FIX = a sustained-music-offset PROPOSER: scan for >=8-10s high-musicProbability run, PROPOSE a candidate boundary at its trailing edge, then ~100ms flatness/RMS refine to ~+-0.3s. The bedSustainMusicProb primitive exists; needs to feed candidate GENERATION not just refinement. COVERAGE: page-turn stinger(j3dc)=2 mid-roll seams + music-offset=1 post-roll = ~3 of doac 4 structural boundaries acoustically addressable; pre-roll/Helix intro NOT solved (continuous music-under-host past content-start, needs lexical/FM). GOLD GAP: the post-roll is ABSENT from all 3 corpus golds (they show 3 breaks: preroll+2 midroll) => post-roll currently UNMEASURED, extend gold before crediting a detector. Artifacts: doac0709/0713_playout_bed.wav, feat.py/ncc.py/proxy.py/env.py.
MUSIC-OFFSET PROPOSER BUILT + SCORED (2026-07-17 subagent, scratchpad/musicoffset/). VIABLE high-precision deterministic post-roll proposer FOR THE SUBSET of shows with an instrumental outro. Recovers ~9-11 of ~21 audit post-roll misses: 11/20 episodes get >=1 within +-20s, 6 within +-5s (byte-refine tight: Conan -0.3s, Morbid-bonus -0.8s, PlanetMoney -1.8s). Reliable playout->ad: DOAC/Morbid/SmartLess/PlanetMoney (9/9). ZERO false post-rolls on 5/6 controls (music-under-speech does NOT trigger - speech pauses/flux break the predicate; only FP = Night Vale atmospheric fiction). NOT general: ~8 DRY-AD shows (Nikki/TheMove/some Conan/Chris-Hayes/Fresh-Air post-roll) cut abruptly with NO music -> 0 (these are FM/host-read territory, no deterministic cue); ~2 heavily-scored shows (Radiolab/Casefile) OVER-propose (14 runs, cannot pin). Best as a TARGETING/attention signal ("an ad begins right after this music") feeding FM/byte-refine, not a standalone verdict. CRITICAL DETECTOR-DESIGN INSIGHT: the pipeline's OWN music formula (tonalness*0.55+stability*0.30+energy*0.15) does NOT discriminate - spectral-flatness->tonalness SATURATES near 1.0 on all podcast audio (content 0.739 vs ad 0.776 = useless). The real separators = PAUSE-FRACTION + fine SPECTRAL-FLUX (playout 0.018/0.201 vs speech 0.270/0.375), composite window AUC 0.991. => the pipeline music-bed detection should add pause-fraction + subflux features. Bonus: 6 proposals byte-refined EXISTING mid-roll breaks (SYSK 1308 vs 1310) = independent corroboration.
ELEVATED to top priority (Dan, 2026-07-17) alongside riiz (music-feature upgrade, its ENABLER). Music-offset is validated as a high-precision post-roll proposer for instrumental-outro shows (~9-11 of 21 post-roll gold-misses, 6 byte-tight, 0 control FPs). Depends on riiz features (pause-fraction + subflux) for reliable music detection.
IMPL WITH xtpf (approved 2026-07-18). NEW FILE SustainedMusicOffsetProposer.swift = pure enum, static propose(featureWindows:episodeDuration:config:)->[ProposedSpan]. KEY SIMPLIFICATION (riiz merged): threshold on the already-persisted FeatureWindow.musicProbability directly (the is_music_window predicate is baked into the composite; FeatureWindow carries rms/spectralFlux/musicProbability/pauseProbability, NOT sub-frame PF/SF/TON). ALGO (ported find_music_runs/refine_trailing): scan sorted featureWindows, maximal runs where musicProbability>=musicRunThreshold(~0.76) with 1-window gap tolerance; keep runs>=minRunSeconds(8-10s=>4-5 windows); propose [runStart, trailingEdge=first sub-threshold window at run end]; confidence=run strength (mean prob or len*prob). Reuse FineBoundaryRefiner for the +-0.3s trailing-edge snap (or let step-13 refine handle once decoded - recommended PR1).
