SemanticScanStatusTests.legacyGenerationErrorStillMapsAfterFix (playhead-l3r2 guard) FAILS: SemanticScanStatus.from(error: LanguageModelSession.GenerationError.exceededContextWindowSize(context)) != .exceededContextWindow. UNRELATED to any scheduler/bbut change.

ROOT-CAUSE HYPOTHESIS: from(error:) (SemanticScanStatus.swift:72) tries the iOS-27 casts FIRST — LanguageModelError (l.85), GeneratedContent.ParsingError (l.95), LanguageModelSession.Error (l.99), SystemLanguageModel.Error (l.105) — BEFORE the legacy LanguageModelSession.GenerationError cast (l.108). On the current Xcode-beta iOS-27 SDK, a legacy GenerationError.exceededContextWindowSize evidently ALSO satisfies one of those iOS-27 casts (most likely LanguageModelSession.Error at l.99, added by cle1/#249), so it is intercepted and mapped by from(sessionError:)/etc. instead of from(generationError:) (which correctly maps exceededContextWindowSize -> .exceededContextWindow at l.133). This is precisely the reverse-direction regression l3r2's test exists to catch. Could be a code-ordering bug introduced by cle1/#249 OR an Xcode-beta SDK update changing the error-type hierarchy under us.

PROCESS ISSUE (important): this was MASKED because the swarm's gate wrapper shipped in qt8y/#281 used -parallel-testing-worker-count 2, which dies at simctl clone spawn (exit 65, ZERO tests run) on this box — so gates via scripts/fast-gate.sh executed NO tests. Fixed by ekpn/#282 (single-host). Recommend re-running a REAL full gate on plain main to confirm main is red and to surface anything else the broken wrapper masked.

NEXT: (1) confirm on plain main (single-host gate); (2) if red, reorder from(error:) so the legacy GenerationError cast is tried appropriately / add an explicit guard so exceededContextWindowSize maps correctly on iOS-27 (FM-sensitive — get approval); (3) unblocks clean verification of other PRs (e.g. bbut/#283).
notes: FALSE ALARM — closing. I misread Swift Testing's #expect / __checkBinaryOperation macro-EXPANSION output in the gate log as a test failure. It is NOT: SemanticScanStatusTests.legacyGenerationErrorStillMapsAfterFix PASSES deterministically — confirmed twice, in the full bbut/#283 gate (8353 tests, 0 failures, TEST SUCCEEDED) AND a focused warm re-run (all 9 SemanticScanStatus tests pass, exit 0). from(error:) maps exceededContextWindowSize -> .exceededContextWindow correctly on iOS-27. No regression; no masked-gate issue on this test. Root error: I grepped for failure-ish patterns and concluded a failure before reading the authoritative 'Test run with N tests passed / 0 failures' summary.

title: fix: fast-gate.sh clone flag (-parallel-testing-worker-count) breaks on CommandLineTools xcode-select
description: playhead-qt8y (#281) shipped scripts/fast-gate.sh using -parallel-testing-worker-count 2 to cap sim clones. On this box that FAILS every run: worker-count >=2 makes Xcode spawn simulator CLONES, and the clone helper resolves simctl via the GLOBAL xcode-select — which is /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools (no simctl) — so it dies with 'xcrun: error: unable to find utility simctl' (exit 65, ~18s, zero tests run). DEVELOPER_DIR fixes xcodebuild but NOT the clone helper (2026-07-16 gotcha). Verified: env -u DEVELOPER_DIR xcrun --find simctl => not found; global xcode-select -p => CommandLineTools. CLAUDE.md also recommends the broken wrapper with a '~57% free' measurement that was never actually captured (the bounded runs failed). FIX: run the gate SINGLE-HOST (no clone flag) — matching the default gate that works (XCTest serial + Swift Testing in-process concurrency) — keep the self-healing (auto-xcodegen on missing scheme + sim -308 recovery), and correct CLAUDE.md (document the clone/simctl gotcha; the real memory guardrail is running ONE gate at a time, not in-gate clone capping). Enabling real clone parallelism would need a global xcode-select change (sudo, system-wide) = NEEDS-DAN.

title: Reduce Swift test-suite memory footprint, flakiness, and full-gate wall-clock time
description:
The PlayheadFastTests full gate (~7,900 tests) saturates this 16 GB machine: parallel Swift Testing + XCTest execution drives free memory to ~86 MB and the simulator's Playhead.app test host alone reaches ~1 GB RSS. Under that pressure runs get interrupted mid-suite (`** BUILD INTERRUPTED **`, exit 144 / signal-terminated) with no test-level failure — pure resource exhaustion. When any second xcodebuild runs concurrently (e.g. a parallel verification gate on the same worktree) the OOM is near-certain, which is why CLAUDE.md already caps concurrent xcodebuild at 2. The cost is repeated wasted full-gate runs, non-deterministic "failures" that are really kills, and long wall-clock feedback loops (build + ~7,900 tests). This makes per-bead verification slow and erodes trust in the gate result.

Goal: make the full gate + focused suites cheaper in peak memory, more deterministic (no OOM/interruption flakes), and faster in wall-clock — without weakening coverage.
acceptance_criteria:
- Characterize peak memory of a full PlayheadFastTests run (per-process RSS over time: test host, testmanagerd, sourcekit, xcodebuild) and identify the top drivers.
- Reduce peak memory enough that a full gate completes reliably on a 16 GB box with headroom (no BUILD INTERRUPTED / signal-144 kills across N consecutive runs). Candidate levers to evaluate: bound Swift Testing / XCTest parallel worker count (e.g. -parallel-testing-worker-count or .xctestplan maximumParallelization), split the gate into sequential shards, tune per-suite `.serialized`, drop/scope heavyweight in-memory fixtures, evict AnalysisStore shard-cache between suites.
- Reduce full-gate wall-clock (measure before/after; target a meaningful % improvement without dropping tests) — e.g. right-size parallelism to the box, cut redundant rebuilds, cache the built test bundle.
- Reduce known load-sensitive flakes: the gy2s pipeline-stall / RouteChange / Interruption / PlaybackService audio-session / playhead-7h2 runtime-shutdown families that only fail under CPU/mem saturation. Either de-flake or ensure they are gated like the PerfGate measurement tests.
- Document the chosen knobs in CLAUDE.md (test plans, parallelism ceiling) so agents run the gate the cheap way by default.
- No reduction in test coverage; PlayheadFastTests remains the per-bead gate and a true subset of PlayheadIntegrationTests.
notes: Surfaced 2026-07-23 while verifying playhead-xsdz.71: a concurrent second gate on the same worktree drove free memory to ~86 MB and repeatedly interrupted the full gate (exit 144, then a truncated run). CLAUDE.md context: 16 GB box, max 2 concurrent xcodebuild, PerfGate load-sensitive tests already opt-out of parallel runs (playhead-zx0l). Related prior art: scripts/perf-tests.sh serial pass; PlayheadFastTests vs PlayheadIntegrationTests test plans.

title: Post-roll ad unmarkable: transcription stops short of episode end AND marking is gated on transcript coverage
description:
## Problem (dogfood 2026-07-22, THEMOVE)
User wanted to mark a POST-ROLL ad but "transcription appears not to have quite finished" — the post-roll was both uncovered AND unmarkable.

## Root cause: intersection of two shipped behaviors
1. **Transcription stops short of the true end.** For any episode > ~15 min the coverage ladder caps deep transcription at `t2DepthSeconds = 900s` (PreAnalysisConfig.swift:18); catch-up lags the playhead (fires only when transcribedAhead<60s, AnalysisWorkScheduler.swift:1580) and is thermal/budget-gated. Even a "full" finalize deliberately tolerates the last ~5% via `finalizeBackfillMinCoverageRatio = 0.95` (AnalysisCoordinator.swift:296). Transcript-reach in (0,0.95) terminates `.completeTranscriptPartial` with an abandoned tail (classifyBackfillTerminal, :2292-2299). The final pass only re-transcribes ALREADY-DETECTED ad windows (FinalPassRetranscriptionRunner.swift:303-319), so an undetected post-roll is never backfilled.
2. **Markability is gated on transcript coverage.** The transcript-peek "Mark ad" flow (TranscriptPeekView.swift:442-449,547-582) can only assemble a mark from EXISTING transcript chunks, which extend only to `fastTranscriptCoverageEndTime` (TranscriptPeekViewModel.swift:253 <- TranscriptPeekDataSource.swift:143). No chunks in the post-roll -> nothing to tap -> `submitMarkedChunks` early-returns. (The player-view "Hearing an ad" button, NowPlayingViewModel.swift:205-249, is NOT coverage-gated — it seeds at the playhead + BoundaryExpander seed±30s — but it's not discoverable from the transcript tail.)
The persistence path (recordUserMarkedAd AdDetectionService.swift:2717; injectUserMarkedAd PlayheadRuntime.swift:3266) accepts arbitrary start/end with NO coverage clamp — the block is purely in the transcript-selection UI.

## Log evidence (on-device asset-lifecycle-log)
3 episodes ended `.completeTranscriptPartial` this session: a 76.5-min episode transcribed only 24.5 min (ratio 0.320 — whole back half incl. post-roll untranscribed; likely the THEMOVE ep), a 29-min at 0.790, one anomalous. Terminal reason logged: "partial transcript 1470.0/4590.3s (ratio 0.320 < 0.950)".

## Fix (smallest sites)
1. **Decouple markability from coverage (highest leverage, smallest):** let the user mark an ad in the untranscribed tail — add a "mark from last chunk to end / post-roll" affordance or surface the coverage-free `reportHearingAd`/`injectUserMarkedAd` entry from the transcript peek's empty tail (TranscriptPeekView.swift:442-449,547-582). Persistence already accepts arbitrary spans.
2. **Close the coverage gap (secondary):** a tail-completion coverage target that always transcribes the final segment (bounded by t2DepthSeconds PreAnalysisConfig.swift:18) and/or raise `finalizeBackfillMinCoverageRatio` toward 1.0 (AnalysisCoordinator.swift:296) — tradeoff: extra BG budget/battery on long episodes; 0.95 exists to tolerate decoder trailing-silence.

Related: post-roll under-coverage matches the Gold Undercount note (post-roll 21/35 missing). Connects to backfill starvation (rediff BGTask fired 0x on-device this session too).
acceptance_criteria: User can mark an ad in the untranscribed tail/post-roll (markability decoupled from transcript coverage; persistence already accepts arbitrary spans); optionally a tail-completion pass covers the episature end; a test marks an ad past fastTranscriptCoverageEndTime and asserts the userMarked AdWindow persists with those bounds.

title: User-added ad marks (false-negatives) silently undone by re-analysis re-derivation — correction channel is suppress-only
description:
## Problem (dogfood 2026-07-22, THEMOVE)
User manually marked missed ads; a later re-analysis pass silently UNDID the marking. User corrections must be sacred — no automated pass may undo them.

## Root cause (code-grounded): the correction channel is SUPPRESS-ONLY
User REMOVALS (false-positive vetoes) are protected; user ADDITIONS (false-negative "Hearing an ad" marks) are NOT — they get only a soft <=2x confidence boost, no authoritative protection against re-derivation.

1. **No false-negative read-side.** `activeFalsePositiveScopes` (UserCorrectionStore.swift:1048-1062) EXCLUDES `.falseNegative` by design; `StoreBackedCorrectionMaskProvider` (AtomEvidence.swift:197-266) only emits `.userVetoed`; the `.userConfirmed` mask (AtomEvidence.swift:150) is DEAD — never produced or consumed (AtomEvidenceProjector.swift:298 only special-cases `.userVetoed`). The xsdz.34 §5 rediff absorb-gate (AdDetectionService.swift:6433-6453) keys entirely on `.userVetoed`, so it protects removals ONLY.
2. **Re-derivation ignores the user's addition.** `applyRediffSlotOwnershipPass` (AdDetectionService.swift:6575-6616) + `SpliceSlotRewriter.apply` (SpliceSlotDisposition.swift:339-412) + `deleteDecodedSpans`/`upsertDecodedSpans` (AnalysisStore.swift:11906-12014) do ZERO provenance filtering. The user's added mark contributes only `correctionBoostFactor` (<=2x, AdDetectionService.swift:3940-3947), which the width rewrite overrides.
3. **The false-negative replay that would re-assert the mark doesn't run on this path.** `correctionReplayCandidates` (AdDetectionService.swift:9780-9886) runs ONLY in `runHotPathResult` (:3244), NOT in `runBackfill`. Rediff/backfill go `revalidateFromFeatures -> runBackfill`, which does not replay false-negatives.

Net: any `runBackfill` re-derivation (rediff OR the analysis.backfill/preanalysis.recovery passes) recomputes the region as if the user's addition never happened. The standalone `userMarked` AdWindow ROW survives (isReconcilableBackfillWindow protects it, AdDetectionService.swift:7504-7530), but the region's re-derived detection/auto-skip — the thing the user was correcting — is retired (reconcileBackfillWindows -> store.reconcileBackfillAdWindows DELETE, :5425-5436).

## Log evidence / correction
On-device `bg-task-log` shows the rediff-refetch BGTask NEVER fired (0x; only preanalysis.recovery 604x, feed-refresh 177x, analysis.backfill 135x). So Dan's "rediff was fetched" is a mis-attribution — the culprit is the GENERAL `runBackfill` re-derivation (backfill/recovery), not rediff. The bug is BROADER than rediff and already live in the shipped mark-only/backfill path.

## Why it matters / gating
Trust-critical: silently undoing user corrections violates the app's core promise. ALSO an activation blocker for the xsdz.36 rediff auto-skip rollout (can't ship an auto pass that clobbers corrections).

## Fix (smallest sites — mirror xsdz.34 for false-negatives)
1. Symmetric false-negative read-side: add `activeFalseNegativeScopes` (UserCorrectionStore.swift:1048); map them -> `.userConfirmed` in `makeCorrectionMaskProvider` (AdDetectionService.swift:7651-7660) + `StoreBackedCorrectionMaskProvider.init(fromScopes:)` (AtomEvidence.swift:220-240); make `.userConfirmed` force-anchor at AtomEvidenceProjector.swift:298; add a rediff §5-style gate forbidding absorb/demote/rewrite of a user-added region (AdDetectionService.swift:6433-6453).
2. Provenance-aware rewrite: exclude `.userCorrection` spans from `supersededIds`/`absorbedIds` (SpliceSlotDisposition.swift:359-361,401-404) and the persistence delete (AdDetectionService.swift:6607-6609).
3. Optional trigger guard: skip/non-destructive rediff+backfill for episodes with active `.falseNegative` corrections (RediffRefetchProduction.swift:73-103).
acceptance_criteria: A user-added (false-negative) ad mark survives any runBackfill/rediff re-derivation — the region's detection/auto-skip is NOT retired or reshaped; symmetric false-negative protection (.userConfirmed force-anchor + rediff absorb-gate + provenance-aware rewrite) mirrors the xsdz.34 veto path; a regression test marks a missed ad then runs backfill+rediff revalidation and asserts the mark's detection persists; gating dependency noted for the xsdz.36 auto-skip rollout.
notes:
DOGFOOD ADDENDUM (Dan): 'the ads were different on the second marking' — the re-derivation is NON-DETERMINISTIC, not just correction-blind. So the re-analysis (i) drops the user's added mark AND (ii) produces a DIFFERENT ad set than the first pass. This COMPOUNDS the fix: protecting user additions (this bead) is necessary but NOT sufficient — the un-marked regions still flip run-to-run. Connect to playhead-1wr9 (run-to-run nondeterminism: boundary flips) — xsdz.59/.60 (FM determinism) are CLOSED but on-device instability persists. STRATEGIC: reinforces xsdz.62 (rediff-as-primary: rotation is DETERMINISTIC ad ground truth) + playhead-pzy2 (byte-exact rediff-certain spans exempt from lexical/self-promo demotion) — deterministic certainty should outrank the flippy FM/lexical layer. A user-added mark is ALSO a deterministic-certainty signal and should be treated with the same authority as a byte-exact rediff span. CAVEAT (unresolved): if the episode was re-DOWNLOADED (DownloadManager, not the 0x-fired rediff BGTask) the DAI may have served a genuinely different ad fill -> marks anchored to wall-clock time misalign with new audio -> marks would need content/fingerprint anchoring, a harder problem. Distinguish before implementing.
RESOLVED (Dan 2026-07-22): the episode was NOT deleted or re-downloaded — SAME audio. So 'different ads on second marking' is definitively NON-DETERMINISTIC re-analysis of IDENTICAL persisted input, NOT DAI re-fetch rotation. Implications: (1) content/fingerprint anchoring of marks is NOT needed — wall-clock/time-based marks are fine since the audio is stable; the fix is purely (a) pin user-added marks as deterministic authority (never re-derived/retired) + (b) stabilize the re-derivation. (2) The pipeline is non-deterministic on IDENTICAL input on-device — xsdz.60 greedy decoding (CLOSED) did NOT fully eliminate it, so the non-determinism is either FM-not-actually-greedy-on-device or elsewhere (fusion/ordering/concurrency); see playhead-1wr9. This makes the deterministic-certainty framing decisive: user marks + byte-exact rediff must be treated as fixed ground truth that the flippy FM/lexical layer can never override or reshape.
CORRECTION (Dan 2026-07-22): the AUDIO ITSELF ROTATED — 'the ads in the audio were different, somehow the audio rotated' — even though Dan did NOT delete or re-download. So my 'same-audio non-determinism' note is WRONG: the audio artifact changed. LOG EVIDENCE (asset-lifecycle-log): episodeDurationSec is UNSTABLE for the same asset — 347B688D 1080->4590s, B994F346 1541->690->528s (SHRANK, impossible transcript ratio 2.158), 2CFD65CB 720->528s. Shrinking durations + coverage ratio>1 are impossible for a fixed local file => the DAI enclosure was RE-FETCHED and a different-length stitch replaced the audio. ROOT of all symptoms: the played/marked audio and the analyzed audio can be DIFFERENT DAI stitches, so marks (on stitch A) misalign with the rotated audio (stitch B), and re-analysis finds different ads. This is bigger than correction-protection: it is an AUDIO-ARTIFACT-STABILITY bug. Split into a new bead (audio rotation) — 527u remains the correction-pinning half but is downstream of pinning ONE immutable audio artifact per episode. Mechanism (what re-fetches the played audio) UNDER INVESTIGATION.

title: Episode summaries dominated by ads — summarizer has no ad-exclusion step
description:
## Problem
User-facing episode summaries + topic chips (EpisodeListView expanded row) are dominated by AD content instead of the episode. Dogfood 2026-07-22 (THEMOVE TdF 2026 Stage 17, 48 min, iPhone build @ main 0d05441e): the cycling episode summarized as "buying cars online, financing... the challenges of car shopping. It also covers racing events in Belgium and travel logistics..." with topics "car shopping online / car financing / racing in Belgium". A car-buying sponsor read crowded out the actual Tour de France content.

## Root cause (investigated, code-grounded)
On-device FM summarizer (`EpisodeSummaryExtractor`, EpisodeSummaries/) is fed the FULL RAW transcript with NO ad-exclusion, amplified by a narrow positional sample and a partial-transcript watermark gate:

1. NO AD-EXCLUSION STEP (primary). `fetchTranscriptChunks` (AnalysisStore.swift:6957) = `SELECT * FROM transcript_chunks ... ORDER BY chunkIndex` — no join to ad_windows, no ad predicate; `TranscriptChunk` carries no ad-classification field. A grep of the whole EpisodeSummaries/ dir for adwindow|decodedspan|confirmed.?ad|sponsor|exclude|isAd returns ZERO hits. Detected ads (ad_windows AnalysisStore.swift:335, DecodedSpan :11844, confirmedAdCoverageEndTime :495) are never consulted — even a perfectly-detected Carvana ad is fed to the model at full weight. The prompt (EpisodeSummaryExtractor.swift:170-183) never instructs the model to ignore ads.

2. NARROW POSITIONAL SAMPLE amplifies it. `EpisodeSummarySampler.sample` keeps opening 180s + middle 120s + closing 180s ~= 480s of a 48-min episode (EpisodeSummaryExtractor.swift:72-133,87-92). A 2-3 min pre-roll sits inside the opening 180s window and thus becomes 30-40% of the entire text handed to the model -> it dominates.

3. PARTIAL-TRANSCRIPT WATERMARK GATE (same frontier-vs-area confusion as playhead-sd71). Candidate SQL (AnalysisStore.swift:12560-12591, :12572) gates on `fastTranscriptCoverageEndTime / episodeDurationSec >= 0.8` — a MAX(endTime) WATERMARK, not `fastTranscriptCoveredSec` (interval union). So an episode with the fast pass having merely REACHED 80% of the timeline but only ~39% actually transcribed still qualifies, and summaries run on a sparse fast-pass transcript BEFORE final-pass re-transcription and ad detection complete. The config comment even claims it mirrors a covered-fraction, but the SQL uses the watermark — a real mismatch.

## Fix (smallest sites)
1. EXCLUDE confirmed-ad spans before sampling (highest leverage): in `AnalysisStoreEpisodeSummaryBackfillCandidateProvider.hydrate` (EpisodeSummaryBackfillCoordinator.swift:122-142) also fetch `fetchAdWindows`/`fetchDecodedSpans` and drop transcript chunks overlapping confirmed-ad spans before building `EpisodeSummaryBackfillInput.chunks`; filter correspondingly in `EpisodeSummaryExtractor.extract` / `EpisodeSummarySampler.sample` (:478-495, :72-133).
2. GATE ON REAL COVERAGE + AD COMPLETION: change the candidate SQL (:12572) to use `fastTranscriptCoveredSec` (union) and/or require `confirmedAdCoverageEndTime` to have advanced, so summaries don't run on 39%-covered or pre-ad-detection transcripts.
3. PROMPT HARDENING + SCHEMA BUMP: add an explicit "exclude advertisements / sponsor reads" instruction to `buildPrompt` / `buildPermissivePrompt` (:170-183, :215-231); bump `EpisodeSummary.currentSchemaVersion` (EpisodeSummary.swift:41) so existing contaminated rows are invalidated and regenerated.

## Notes
Deeply ironic for an ad-avoidance app; user-facing (EpisodeListView.swift:572 summary + :577-584 topic chips). Detection is a functioning separate subsystem whose output the summarizer simply ignores — NOT an ad-detection miss. Shares the frontier-vs-covered-area watermark confusion with playhead-sd71.
acceptance_criteria: Summaries and topics exclude confirmed-ad content; summarization gated on real (interval-unioned) transcript coverage + ad-detection completion, not the fastTranscript watermark; a regression test feeds a transcript containing a known ad span and asserts the advertiser/product does NOT appear in summary or topics; EpisodeSummary schema version bumped so existing contaminated summaries regenerate.

title: AN pipeline metric: report analyzed COVERAGE (gap-aware area), not frontier reach
description:
## Problem
The Activity pipeline debug strip's **AN** (`analysisFraction`) is computed as
`max(featureCoverageEndSec, confirmedAdCoverageEndSec) / episodeDurationSec` in
`ActivitySnapshotProvider.swift:502-505` — a high-water END cursor ("how far the
analysis frontier has REACHED"), NOT an area. By contrast **TX**
(`transcriptFraction`) is `fastTranscriptCoveredSec` (interval-unioned ACTUAL
seconds via `AnalysisCoverageMath.unionedSeconds`) / duration.

Observed on dogfood 2026-07-22 (THEMOVE, iPhone build @ main 0d05441e): **AN 100%
while TX 39%**. That is an invariant violation — you cannot analyze audio you have
not transcribed, so AN can never truthfully exceed TX. "Where analysis reaches is
not a useful measurement" (Dan). A misleading AN=100 masks a real coverage gap,
which is exactly the signal we rely on while debugging backfill reliability.

## Fix
Make AN report **actual analyzed COVERAGE** (gap-aware unioned area), mirroring
TX's `unionedSeconds` approach. This needs analysis coverage tracked as intervals:
today `analysis_assets` only carries forward end-watermark columns
(`featureCoverageEndTime` / `confirmedAdCoverageEndTime` / `finalPassCoverageEndTime`);
there is no analyzed-interval table. Interim (small, immediately honest): clamp
`AN <= TX` and, if useful, surface the frontier separately, e.g. "AN 39% (frontier 100%)".

## Sites
- `Playhead/Services/Activity/ActivitySnapshotProvider.swift` — the live-strip block (~319) AND the dogfood-diagnostics block (500-505).
- `AnalysisCoverageSummary` in `AnalysisStore.swift:483-501` (add unioned analyzed seconds if we take the true-area route).
- `PipelineProgressStripView.swift` (display) and `DiagnosticsExportService` (analysis_fraction export).

## Notes
Related to the honest-cursor line (main HEAD `playhead-t1kq`). The debug strip is
off-by-default (Settings toggle) so not user-facing, but it is our primary
analysis-health signal during the backfill-reliability push.
acceptance_criteria: AN reports gap-aware analyzed coverage (unioned area), never exceeds TX for the same asset; a test asserts the AN<=TX invariant; the live strip, dogfood diagnostics, and DiagnosticsExportService all use the corrected value.

title: Scarcity-aware backfill queue ordering: next-to-play priority when backlog exceeds one window
description: Fable analysis 2026-07-22. Within-lane selection is plain FIFO (AnalysisStore.swift:8505 ORDER BY priority DESC, createdAt ASC). When backlog exceeds what one BG window can drain, actively bump next-to-play (playlist/queue position, then most-recent episode of most-listened shows, then user-queued) into the Soon band — extends the y5mk proximity-hint mechanism with a re-prioritization pass in the reconciler / at window entry. Makes a scarce 10-min grant cover the episode the user presses play on tomorrow (felt-experience: banner ready at playback). MED/S-M. Mild product (which signal ranks first — default: playlist order then pub-date recency); safe to implement with that default.

title: Opportunistic backlog drain during playback sessions (relax admissionBlocksDeferred for OTHER episodes)
description: Fable analysis 2026-07-22 — the STRATEGIC CENTERPIECE (removes iOS discretion for anyone who listens daily). BUG FOUND: AnalysisWorkScheduler.admissionBlocksDeferred() (:1381) BLOCKS all deferred backlog work whenever audio is playing — (foreground,playing)/(background,playing)/(background,paused) all BLOCK; only the active episode's catch-up (yqax) runs. So the ONE time the app is guaranteed alive daily (a listening session) the backlog does NOT drain. FIX: relax admission so (*,playing) admits Soon/Background-lane work for OTHER episodes when: active-episode hot-path is caught up (coverage comfortably ahead of playhead), QualityProfile=.nominal, and charging-or-battery-above-threshold. Reuses existing lane caps/leases/preemption — policy change in LaneAdmission, not a new subsystem. Background playback keeps the process legitimately alive (real audio, App-Store-fine). RISK: CPU/battery/thermal on long unplugged sessions; FM contention (mlhostd core-pin) may need FM to stay foreground/charging-only. HIGH/M. NEEDS-DAN: the battery/thermal ADMISSION GATE DEFAULTS are a product tradeoff (propose: admit only when .nominal AND charging-or->50%, hot-path-caught-up); implementation otherwise autonomous-safe.
notes:
DEFERRED during autonomous run (2026-07-23): bead is explicitly NEEDS-DAN — the battery/thermal admission-gate defaults are a felt-experience product tradeoff (long unplugged sessions, mlhostd/FM core-pin contention) that Dan owns. Implementation is autonomous-safe but the on/off + defaults need his ratification, so holding until he's back rather than shipping the strategic centerpiece on an unratified tradeoff.
DECISION RATIFIED (Dan, 2026-07-23): power gate = CHARGING-ONLY. Admit Soon/Background-lane backlog work for OTHER episodes during a playback session ONLY when: device is CHARGING AND QualityProfile == .nominal AND the active episode's hot-path is caught up (coverage comfortably ahead of playhead). FM-heavy work (mlhostd core-pin) stays charging-only regardless. Rationale: zero battery/thermal downside, captures the at-home/overnight charging-while-listening drain (the big win), protects felt-experience; loosen to charging-OR-batteryPct later once real thermal/battery telemetry exists. Ship flag-gated with this as the default. Now autonomous-safe to implement.

title: Auto-download latest-N is dead: BGAppRefreshTask starved by over-eager resubmit (0/131 starts in 8 days)
description:
Dan dogfood 2026-07-22: 'download latest X episodes' never downloads.

ROOT CAUSE (device log-proven): the ONLY trigger for auto-download-latest-N is the com.playhead.app.feed-refresh BGAppRefreshTask, and it has NEVER fired — bg-task-log.jsonl 2026-07-13..07-21 shows submit:131 start:0 complete:0. Meanwhile preanalysis.recovery started 124x and analysis.backfill 3x in the same window, so Background App Refresh is enabled and BGProcessingTasks get windows fine — only the AppRefreshTask is starved.

MECHANISM: BackgroundFeedRefreshService.scheduleNextRefresh() (:467) unconditionally submits a BGAppRefreshTaskRequest(earliestBeginDate = now+3600s) and is called from start() (:453) on EVERY app launch — including the ~30-min background launches iOS grants to preanalysis.recovery (PlayheadApp.swift:434). BGTaskScheduler.submit dedupes by identifier so each resubmit REPLACES the pending request, pushing earliestBeginDate ~30 min into the future before the 60-min floor can ever mature. iOS never reaches the begin-date -> 0 dispatches. No getPendingTaskRequests guard anywhere in the app (verified 0 usages).

The 19 assets on device were ALL created by the play-driven scheduler path (asset-lifecycle-log schedulerPlaybackContext:'playing'), which is why downloads APPEAR to work while auto-download is silently dead.

SECONDARY GATES:
1) AutoDownloadOnSubscribe defaults .off (SettingsL274.swift:126) — even with the task firing, pickEpisodesForDownload returns [] unless set to Last1/Last3/All. (Product decision: should it default on?)
2) Foreground pull-to-refresh does NOT compensate: LibraryView.refreshAllFeeds (:265-279) discovers/inserts episodes but DISCARDS the result (let _ = try await refreshEpisodes) and never routes through pickEpisodesForDownload+enqueueBackgroundDownload.

FIX:

title: Immediate (day-0, same-session) rediff: at play-time, context-varied k-way double-fetch + byte-align to mark DAI ads on FIRST listen
description:
Dan 2026-07-21: the PRODUCT PAYOFF of the rediff-activation cluster - the capstone at the end of it. Today rediff is a LAGGED oracle (needs a >=24h re-fetch -> a drop-day listener gets ad marks only on a later re-analysis). IMMEDIATE rediff runs at PLAY TIME (day-0, same session): when the user starts an episode, on-device fetch a SECOND copy with VARIED request context (different live UA header + cache-buster + k-way >=3 fetches) -> byte-align diff (sample-exact) -> mark the DAI ad slots IMMEDIATELY, so the user gets marks on first listen, not next-day.

TIES TOGETHER (this is their culmination): xsdz.45 (context-variation, P0 - REQUIRED: survey proved AdsWizz+Art19 pin per client, so a single-device same-context double-fetch returns identical files = nothing to diff; varying the live UA header is what produces a divergent B-side), xsdz.36.2 (k-way >=3 to beat per-slot collisions), xsdz.36.3 (ephemeral session + original-enclosure + cache-buster), xsdz.44 (byte-align, sample-exact, network-general - 0/6 shows re-encode).

BANDWIDTH/BATTERY: a full 2nd fetch at play-time is ~50MB. Optimizations: (a) byte-RANGE requests for just the ad-likely regions (pre/mid/post windows) instead of the whole file; (b) gate on wifi/charging OR a user 'deep-scan' toggle; (c) reuse the already-downloading A-side stream. CERTAINTY: byte-exact rediff marks are deterministic -> AUTO-SKIP-eligible (not just banner). This is what turns rediff from a next-day oracle into a real-time DAI detector; per-request shows (Megaphone/Omny) work with cache-buster alone, pinned shows (AdsWizz/Art19) need the UA variation.

title: Cross-network DAI-dynamics survey: per-request vs pinned vs baked + byte-align generalization across shows/networks
description: Empirical foundation for the rediff-activation + portfolio ranking (Dan 2026-07-21: 'run these tests on other shows'). THEMOVE = 1 data point (Megaphone/libsyn, per-request, no re-encode, byte-align sample-exact). The belt-and-suspenders thesis needs the DISTRIBUTION across networks. Per show, the 5-point battery: (1) k-way same-client fetch -> BAKED (identical files, rediff-blind) vs PER-REQUEST DAI (all differ) vs PINNED DAI (same-client identical but context-varied differs); (2) if pinned, does UA/cookie/interface variation break it; (3) byte-align sample-exact vs whole-file RE-ENCODE (re-encode -> text/chroma bank xsdz.68 becomes the required lever); (4) rediff width coverage; (5) stitch network + ad-markers from the redirect chain (xsdz.71). Network-diverse sample: Megaphone(THEMOVE done), flightcast(DOAC - Dan suspects BAKED), simplecast(Conan), Art19/Wondery(Morbid/BusinessWars/SmartLess), Omny/iHeart, Acast, public-radio(Radiolab/FreshAir). OUTCOMES that move priorities: a pinned show -> promote xsdz.45/.72/.74 to critical; a re-encode network -> promote xsdz.68 text/chroma bank; baked shows -> confirm specialist/bank ownership. Offline (network+python differ, no app build).

title: Byte-align differ: silence-frame resync guard (require >=2s clean run before accepting a match)
description: Rediff test 2026-07-21: byte-identical SILENCE frames across fetches create spurious short matches that a naive byte-aligner false-syncs on -> wrong ad-slot boundaries. Require a >=~2s (~32KB) clean run before accepting a resync (implemented in the test's rediff_multi.py). Port this guard into the production Swift byte-align differ. Correctness robustness for the PROVEN width lever (xsdz.44).
notes:
R1 review 2026-07-22: implemented guard (minCleanRunBytes=32768, branch bead/playhead-xsdz.73 @ b7800713) is STRICTLY INERT at the production default — minCleanRunBytes(32768) < minRunBytes(65536), so max()=65536 always and the guard never fires in prod. A silence island <4s is already dropped by the 65536 floor; one >=4s passes both. NOT MERGED. DESIGN DECISION NEEDED (Dan): (a) does the existing 4s (65536) floor already prevent the silence false-syncs the rediff TEST saw with its weaker 1s guard (l2f-dai-rediff.py MIN_RUN_FPS=8)? If so xsdz.73 may be moot. (b) if LONG (>4s) byte-identical silence runs are the real problem, a length floor can't fix it — need silence-CONTENT detection (reject low-entropy/repeated-frame runs as non-evidence regardless of length). (c) if finer boundaries are wanted, LOWER minRunBytes (tuning the proven width lever) + keep minCleanRunBytes as the silence floor — but lowering minRunBytes needs Dan. Also: implementer FABRICATED a rediff_multi.py MIN_RUN=32768 citation (nonexistent); R1 fixed the comments. Branch preserved.
VERIFIED + CLOSING 2026-07-22. Empirical check (11 real rotated A/B pairs, scripts/l2f-mp3-forensics.py align at floors 0.125s->4s): the byte-exact aligner structurally CANNOT false-sync on silence — silence in two different DAI fills is not byte-identical (different encodes), so it never produces a matched run. Run/slot structure is byte-for-byte identical from 2048B(0.125s) to 65536B(4s); the proposed guard does ZERO work at any floor. The real silence-false-sync lives in the CHROMAPRINT path (l2f-dai-rediff.py MIN_RUN_FPS=8 / RediffDiffer fallback) — reproduced on freshair (spurious 1.0s@-108 + 3.0s@3265 runs fragmenting a break). Closing as not-applicable to RediffByteAligner. Branch bead/playhead-xsdz.73 discarded (inert). Follow-up filed for the chroma path.

title: DAI stitch-chain + delivery-metadata detector: structural DAI signals from the delivery mechanism (no diff, no fingerprint, no prior sighting)
description:
Belt-and-suspenders method (Dan 2026-07-21: 'different shows/networks may do it differently, we need a dozen methods'). A family of STRUCTURAL DAI signals derived from the DELIVERY mechanism itself - independent of rediff (no re-fetch) and the fingerprint bank (no prior sighting), so it covers cases those miss:

1. REDIRECT-CHAIN / stitch-network detection: the enclosure redirect chain (observed on THEMOVE: pscrb.fm -> podtrac -> megaphone/mgln.ai -> claritas/clrtpod -> traffic.libsyn) identifies WHICH DAI stitching network serves the show and that DAI is present -> a show-level DAI-EXPECTED prior that biases the other detectors + tells us rediff/context-variation is worth attempting. Cheap (parse the redirect chain once per show).

2. DELIVERY-METADATA ad markers: some DAI systems embed insertion-point / ad markers in the manifest, ID3 frames, or chapter markers of the stitched file (VAST-style / Megaphone/ad-marker conventions). If present, these are a DIRECT within-episode ad LOCATOR - no diff needed. Probe the enclosure's ID3/chapters/headers for markers.

3. SEGMENT-JOIN encoding-regime discontinuity: where the stitcher concatenates differently-encoded segments, MACRO encoding-regime shifts (loudness/LUFS, spectral tilt, encoder-state/bitrate-reservoir resets) at segment boundaries structurally mark an insertion. NOTE this is DISTINCT from the dead-ended splice-CLICK detection (xsdz.15, recall 21pct = micro/click-level); this is MACRO span-regime (Fable #8, low-confidence) - a KILL-TEST experiment, not a promise.

Signals 1+2 are the high-value new parts (metadata, near-free); 3 is speculative. Feeds BANNER (single structural signal); auto-skip still needs deterministic agreement. Complements rediff (dynamic DAI), fingerprint bank (repeated creatives), specialist (host-reads) in the [[project detection portfolio]].

title: Detect cue-less 'native ad' host-reads (commercial infotainment woven into editorial)
description:

It was COMMERCIAL INFOTAINMENT: the product woven into race editorial - how the day's stage winner took them + new products coming. No CTA, no promo code, not directed at the listener, cue-less, content-integrated. The HARDEST host-read class ('native advertising').

Connects to: PR4 deferred music-bed lever (insufficient alone), the sliding-window multi-pass idea (sb41, reframed), and the correction->retrain-triples loop.

title: False-positive banners on brand-as-editorial: sports teams named after sponsors (cycling/F1)
description:
Dan dogfood 2026-07-21 (THEMOVE / cycling; also F1): the detector fires MISTAKE banners when hosts discuss teams that are NAMED after their title sponsors - 'the Red Bull team', Ineos Grenadiers, Jumbo-Visma, UAE Team Emirates (cycling); Red Bull, Mercedes, Ferrari, Aston Martin, Alpine (F1). These are EDITORIAL/narrative brand mentions, not ad reads.

ROOT CAUSE: the current shipped pipeline's brand/sponsor lexical signal fires on the brand NAME regardless of context - violates lexical-as-attention (brand should ATTEND, a context-aware verifier should DISPOSE). The distinction is CONTEXT: an ad read has CTA/promo/sponsor-disclosure language + is directed at the listener ('brought to you by Red Bull, go to redbull.com, code...'); a team mention is third-person narrative about the sport ('the Red Bull team won').

FIX (two prongs): (1) DURABLE - the context-aware specialist should classify these not_ad, but its v2 hard-negative set covered intros/credits/comedy-fake-ads, NOT sports-team-as-sponsor brand mentions. Add this HARD-NEGATIVE class to the next retrain (a sharp, dense case: every team mention is a brand). Dan's dogfood CORRECTIONS on these FP banners ARE the training data (correction->retrain flywheel). (2) STOPGAP for the current pipeline (specialist off) - a brand-mention CONTEXT gate: suppress banner when a known sports-team-sponsor brand appears in narrative context (no CTA/promo/URL/second-person 'you'/'code' nearby). Brittle per lexical-as-attention, but reduces annoyance until the specialist ships.

GENERAL CLASS: 'brand mention in editorial context != ad' (also tech podcasts saying Apple/Google as companies); sports-team-as-sponsor is the densest/sharpest instance. Precision hurts BANNER TRUST (a spammy banner breaks peace-of-mind). Evidence: pull Dan's THEMOVE device corrections to quantify + seed the negative set.
notes: DEFERRED during autonomous run (2026-07-23): durable fix = specialist RETRAIN seeded by Dan's THEMOVE FP corrections (not autonomous — needs the correction corpus + retrain). Stopgap = a brittle lexical-VERDICT brand-suppression gate (suppress team-sponsor brand mentions lacking CTA/URL/2nd-person/code cues) — bead itself flags it brittle-per-lexical-as-attention; the brand list + context-cue design + suppression aggressiveness are recall/precision judgment calls on the live banner trust that want Dan's steering + his dogfood correction data. title: iOS-27 LanguageModelError not mapped in SemanticScanStatus.from(error:) — permissive-fallback + smart-shrink silently dead on device
description:
LATENT SHIPPED REGRESSION on iOS 27 (Dan's dogfood iPhone runs iOS 27). Found by playhead-4my.19 re-measure: on iOS/macOS 27 the FM coarse call throws the NEW `LanguageModelError` type (measured 382/382 errors), NOT the legacy `LanguageModelSession.GenerationError`. But SemanticScanStatus.from(error:) (Playhead/Services/AdDetection/SemanticScanStatus.swift:72) only does `error as? LanguageModelSession.GenerationError` (line 79) and otherwise returns .failedTransient (line 84).

CONSEQUENCE on iOS 27:
- Every refusal maps to .failedTransient instead of .refusal => permissive-fallback routing (keyed on .refusal) NEVER fires.
- Every context overflow maps to .failedTransient instead of .exceededContextWindow => smart-shrink retry (keyed on .exceededContextWindow) NEVER fires.
Both recovery mechanisms are silently no-ops on the exact OS the app now ships to.

FIX: add a `LanguageModelError` cast + case mapping in from(error:), guarded by availability/canImport so older SDKs still compile. 4my.19 also captured the typed overflow shape: `LanguageModelError.contextSizeExceeded(contextSize:tokenCount:)` carries both fields (cleanly replaces the fragile 2-format regex). Map its refusal/overflow/rateLimited/etc. cases to the existing SemanticScanStatus cases. Add a regression test that feeds a LanguageModelError and asserts the correct status (the legacy-only path is what let this ship).

title: A skip never eats the show: late-safe start edges (asymmetric auto-skip padding)
notes:
CHARTER (2026-07-19): the auto-skip start edge. Measured: end edges stinger-accurate (p50 2.8s, 0.1s on covered shows) but START p50 24.4s (18.3s covered) — the weak edge. Ship-grade auto-skip therefore pads asymmetrically: skip start = detected start + safety margin (derived from the per-show start-error distribution vs the 2026-07-15 gold ear-audit labels; nikki tolerance 0.5s, others 0.3s), skip end = stinger edge where covered, else conservative. Deliverable: padding policy + per-show margins + measurement vs gold. Gate-2 dependency alongside wraj surfacing + veto masks + 3-run reproducibility.

IMPLEMENTED (2026-07-20, commits 1ae28195+fc52b33a on bead/playhead-98co, review pending): AutoSkipEdgePadding policy + SkipOrchestrator wiring, default-OFF, cue-only. DERIVED MARGINS (docs/autoskip-edge-padding-derivation-2026-07-20.md, harness scripts/l2f-derive-autoskip-padding.py): start 0.50s byte / 0.75s stinger / UNANCHORED=markOnly (covering the +29s-late tail costs ~25s = tier finding); end 0.75s anchored / 10.25s unanchored (cross-build sized); nikki stinger-starts demoted per-show (~30s bimodal misfire — pre-anchor is the fix). Zero in-sample clip events but n=44: 2% target unverifiable (UBs 5-39%/tier) — grow corpus (xdh7) before flag-ON. Flag-ON skips NOTHING until anchor provenance is stamped (new Gate-2 bead).
MERGED (2026-07-20, PR #244, 44577583). Dormant/default-OFF; combined gate = 2 known pre-existing contention flakes (app-delegate scan + skip-budget, on untouched files, fixed on the un-merged #243 branch) which pass quiescent. Gate-2 prerequisites tracked: hdgk (anchor-provenance stamping), the vetoed-span banner-copy surfacing.
2026-07-24 founder reorder: outcome-framed title (was: Asymmetric start-edge padding for auto-skip; start p50 24.4s late-safe, end edges stinger-accurate). Phase 2 Trust.
2026-07-28 QUEUE TRIAGE (Fable): NOT implementable tonight — the implementation is ALREADY MERGED (PR #244, 44577583) and AutoSkipEdgePadding.swift is on main, dormant/default-OFF. The only remaining work is the FLAG-ON decision, and this bead's own notes block it: the 2% clip-rate target is unverifiable at n=44 (upper bounds 5-39% per tier), needing corpus growth via playhead-xdh7 — which is DEFERRED. Flipping it on without that verification is exactly the failure this bead exists to prevent.

NEW INTERACTION with playhead-2350 (merged 08c68bc4): 2350 now requires BOTH edges anchored for auto-skip eligibility, while 98co's measured policy permits an unanchored END when the START is anchored. So AutoSkipEdgePadding.endMarginUnanchoredSeconds is now UNREACHABLE for fusion spans — the 2350 implementer recorded this on the constant so nobody trusts a dead number. When 98co is revisited, reconcile the two policies deliberately: either 2350 relaxes to accept an anchored-start/unanchored-end span with 98co's conservative end margin, or 98co's unanchored-end margin is retired. Do not let them silently disagree.

Downstream: playhead-qs0d is BLOCKED by this bead and is therefore also not implementable until the corpus question is settled.
2026-07-28 DAN DECISION on the 98co-vs-2350 edge-policy conflict: KEEP BOTH, GATED BY CORPUS. 2350's strict rule (BOTH edges independently anchored) governs today. 98co's asymmetry (anchored start + unanchored end with the conservative 10.25s end margin) becomes permitted ONLY once playhead-xdh7 grows the corpus enough to verify the 2% clip-rate target that is currently unverifiable at n=44 (per-tier upper bounds 5-39%).

Rationale for deferring to data rather than judgement: 98co's allowance rests on a MEASURED claim (end edges are stinger-accurate, p50 2.8s / 0.1s covered) that is genuinely credible but thinly sampled; 2350's requirement is EVIDENTIAL (the origin proved the boundary). Rather than pick one on reasoning, hold the strict rule and let the corpus settle whether the measured asymmetry survives at scale.

CONSEQUENCE TO HANDLE DELIBERATELY: AutoSkipEdgePadding.endMarginUnanchoredSeconds is unreachable for fusion spans today. Do NOT delete it — it is the parked half of this decision. Annotate it with the gate condition (permitted only after xdh7 verifies the clip-rate target) so a future reader knows it is DEFERRED, not dead. A dead-looking constant with no explanation is how this contradiction would silently resolve itself the wrong way.

Also note the interaction with playhead-zkcg: if 2350's strictness means essentially nothing ever qualifies for auto-skip, the certainty-tiered policy collapses into 'banner everything', which is exactly what zkcg is measuring. If zkcg's device observation shows that, it is evidence FOR revisiting this gate sooner rather than later.

APPROVED PLAN (Dan, 2026-07-18), Option A. INJECTION: RegionShadowPhase.swift:214-216 (the gate filter) becomes PARTITION-AND-RECOVER. title: Retune RuleBasedClassifier operating point for the un-saturated musicProbability (riiz side-effect, hurts host-read recall)
notes:
FOUND by riiz review Round 2 (adversarial consumer-impact lens), VERIFIED live 2026-07-18. riiz (playhead-riiz) correctly un-saturates acousticMusicProbability: non-music dropped ~0.73(saturated)->~0.40, music-playout ~0.90. SIDE EFFECT on the LIVE classifier: no Layer2 CoreML model is bundled (find for *.mlmodelc/*.mlpackage = empty; CoreMLSequenceClassifier falls back to RuleBasedClassifier for ALL candidates), so RegionScoring.computeMusicScore (ClassifierService.swift:213, min(avgMusic*1.5,1.0), cap 0.5 when avg>0.8) is LIVE in the ad score. Under old saturation speech gave computeMusicScore=min(0.73*1.5,1)=1.0 for ALL speech-dominated candidates (a near-constant inflated baseline); now speech gives min(0.40*1.5,1)=0.60. In RuleBasedClassifier (musicScore weight 0.10, sigmoidMid=0.25 k=8, orchestrator enter=0.65) this is a ~0.034-0.04 lower rawScore -> ~0.06-0.07 lower calibrated adProbability near the 0.65 margin. Because the term never discriminated ad-vs-content for speech (both ~1.0 before, both ~0.60 now), this is a uniform BIAS that de-tunes the operating point DOWNWARD, not better discrimination -> LOWERS recall on borderline HOST-READ ads (Dan priority class, [[feedback_fm_hostread_irreplaceable]]). FIX (consumer-side, was OUT of riiz scope so deferred): EMPIRICALLY retune RuleBasedClassifier.sigmoidMid (lower it to restore the operating point) OR rescale computeMusicScore against the new distribution; pick the value data-driven on the corpus. SEQUENCING: do this BEFORE the trustworthy host-read recall/precision measurement, else host-read recall is confounded by the de-tuned operating point. Depends on riiz landing. Related: CoreMLSequenceClassifier.featureVector also consumes musicProbability directly -> a future trained Layer2 model must train on the NEW distribution (ties to featureVersion bead playhead-sahg).
SHIP-CRITICAL for Gate 1 (2026-07-19): the host-read BANNER lane is the entire host-read product at ship (skip tier comes later via wraj T-floor) and it is de-tuned by riiz v5 (computeMusicScore 1.0->0.60 for speech => ~0.06-0.07 lower ad-prob at the 0.65 margin). Retune sigmoidMid empirically before flipping Gate 1 banners on.
RETUNE LANDED (2026-07-19, commit ccc7d6e4 on bead/playhead-uxte): computeMusicScore gain 1.5 -> 3.0 (RegionScoring.musicScoreGain); sigmoidMid UNCHANGED at 0.25; orchestrator enter 0.65 untouched. MEASUREMENT (same-code A/B, real per-window features from the riiz recalib 2s npz cache, 34 corpus eps; old formula = pipeline_music column, new = shipped composite; exact classifier arithmetic; script scratchpad/uxte_ab.py): speech candidates (n=3098, 30s blocks) avgMusic 0.725+/-0.033 -> 0.434+/-0.074; musicScore 0.993 (94% saturated) -> 0.651+/-0.111; d_raw -0.0342 -> calibrated drop 0.065+/-0.025 at the 0.65 margin (bead's analytic estimate confirmed). FIX CHOICE data-driven: gain-3.0 restoration error -0.0002+/-0.010 ONE-SIDED, restores 2813/3055 fallen borderline candidates; rejected sigmoidMid 0.25->0.2158 (restores only 1372/3055, two-sided +/-0.023, and boosts music-playout up to +0.135 adProb in the timeline-capped case). Playout safety: 98-100% of playout candidates (avgMusic 0.906) take the >0.8 cap branch which the gain does not touch -> byte-identical to post-riiz, strictly below pre-riiz. Known tail: ~1-2% of speech/mus-under-speech candidates with OLD avg>0.8 migrate cap->saturation (+0.05 raw vs pre-riiz; class mean neutral -0.0008). LIVE CORROBORATION (confounded, corroboration only): partial-silver window confidence mean 0.795 -> 0.731 (-0.064) across the same 27 eps pre(0496541e)/post(426058ff) riiz. Tests: RuleBasedClassifierMusicRetuneTests (5 tests: gain pins, cap-branch pins, mirrored-constants bit-parity, 3-state borderline host-read eligible/fell/restored, playout no-new-crossing). Verified: focused waves 25/25 + 78/78 (14 suites incl calibration corpus replay, CorpusFullPipelineTests precision floors, RealEpisodeBenchmarkTests baseline deltas, RegionProposalBuilder, SegmentAggregatorWiring) + re-verify 25/25 after review fixes. Full FastTests not run in worktree (known simctl clone-spawn env failure).
RETUNE IMPLEMENTED (2026-07-19, ccc7d6e4 on bead/playhead-uxte): computeMusicScore gain 1.5->3.0 (musicScoreGain constant; grid optimum 3.03) — chosen over sigmoidMid 0.25->0.2158 head-to-head: restoration error -0.0002+-0.010 ONE-SIDED (never exceeds pre-riiz) vs two-sided +-0.023; restores 2813/3055 fallen borderline candidates vs 1372; playout BYTE-IDENTICAL (cap branch untouched) vs +0.135 max over-boost. A/B on riiz recalibration cache (34 eps, 46k speech windows, real 2s features, exact RuleBasedClassifier arithmetic); live corroboration: partial-silver window confidence -0.064 matches predicted -0.065. Known tail: ~1-2% cap-migration candidates score +0.05 raw vs pre-riiz (class mean neutral). 103 tests green (25 focused + 78 across 14 calibration/replay/benchmark suites). Layer2 retrain note stands. NEXT: independent review then PR.

title: Deterministic detectors must PROPOSE boundaries, not only REFINE: wire stinger / music-offset / acoustic signals as first-class candidate PROPOSERS (not just snap/weight existing FM candidates)
notes:
CROSS-CUTTING CRISP-LANE ENABLER (Dan, 2026-07-17). The pipeline wires acoustic/deterministic signals as REFINEMENT (snap/weight an EXISTING candidate), not PROPOSAL (generate a candidate from acoustic evidence). Evidence (t1py NetSuite finding): MusicBedLedgerEvaluator (AdDetectionService ~6838) is span-scoped PRESENCE evidence - adds one weight to a span that already exists; the music->ad OFFSET is reachable via BracketDetector(0.3)/TimeBoundaryResolver(bedSustainMusicProbThreshold=0.25) but those only REFINE (snap) an existing candidate - NOTHING proposes the post-roll span. So a deterministic detector can fire perfectly and still produce NO span if FM/lexical did not already propose one there. rediff WORKS precisely because it IS a proposer (proposes slots from rotation). PRINCIPLE: every deterministic detector in the crisp lane (spectral stinger j3dc, sustained-music-offset t1py, byte/forensic splices, envelope stingers) must be able to PROPOSE a candidate boundary/span, feeding candidate GENERATION, then let refinement snap it. Likely THE unlock for the crisp/skip lane - without it, deterministic signals are capped by FM recall. Positioned as a P1 ENABLER upstream of j3dc + t1py wiring (they need this seam) and complementary to wraj (routing) + xsdz.62 (rediff-primary). Design: a CandidateProposer protocol/stage where rediff, stinger-match, and sustained-music-offset each emit candidate spans BEFORE the FM/lexical fusion, so quorum + refinement operate on the union.
APPROVED PLAN (Dan, 2026-07-18) — propose-not-refine seam. KEY: the proposer stage ALREADY EXISTS (RegionProposalBuilder.build :176, 6-origin). Acoustic music is refine-only due to TWO chokepoints: (a) WIDTH — makeAcousticProposals :336 emits 1-atom-wide proposals that only gain width by merging into adjacent FM/lexical (FM-missed ad -> no merge -> no ad-width candidate); (b) ANCHOR — AtomEvidenceProjector never lets acoustic coverage independently set isAnchored. xtpf = open both. SEAM: ProposedRegionOrigins.sustainedMusic bit (:3, 1<<6); ProposedSpan type + proposedMusicSpans on RegionProposalInput(:117) + RegionShadowPhase.Input(:47); makeSustainedMusicProposals WIDE via canonicalRange(:577) appended in build(:203); AnchorRef.sustainedMusicOffset(regionId,confidence) (AtomEvidence.swift:19) + Equatable arm(:88, MANDATORY-default:false silently breaks DecodedSpan equality per :101-113) + isWidthOwnership(:77 -> false); AtomEvidenceProjector Path 5 (independent anchoring, mirror classifier Path 4 :246). merge initializer(:526) MUST carry the music field (field-drop bug). DECISIONS approved: (1) extend RegionProposalBuilder not a protocol; (2) proposer inside RegionShadowPhase.run; (3) presence-only/isWidthOwnership=false/fuzzy lane; (4) EXPLICIT "music-only=>never auto-skip" clause in DecisionMapper (BackfillEvidenceFusion :838-858); (5) threshold GO_PORT_AS_IS. Land xtpf+t1py TOGETHER, DEFAULT-OFF flag sustainedMusicProposerEnabled=false (off => proposedMusicSpans=[] => byte-identical no-op), markOnly-only (never auto-skip) = precision-safe. Full plan in tasks/ab29044e output.
SHIPPED default-OFF (PR #233, main 679ba2c1, 2026-07-18). Two-consecutive-clean adversarial review. ACTIVATION FOLLOW-UPS (flag sustainedMusicProposerEnabled stays OFF until measured): (1) flag-ON fire-rate measurement — does t1py actually propose post-roll spans on the real corpus (efficacy is atom-coverage-gated per Finding B); (2) Finding A activation decision — music+rediffSlot agreement currently demotes to markOnly, decide if it should promote to skip; (3) wire the flag through AdDetectionService + trailing-edge boundary-refine (deferred). Enabling needs: measurement + Dan go.
T1PY FLAG-ON MEASUREMENT + FALSE-PREDICTION AUDIT (2026-07-18). Flag-ON capture (throwaway worktree measure-t1py, corpus-root=main) vs flag-OFF baseline, scored 24 shared episodes/82 DAI pods. RESULT: DAI-pod width coverage 12.0%->53.1% (4.4x); pod-recall(>=50%) 4.9%->46.3%; predictions 44->182; auto-skips 0->0 (markOnly held). Raw precision 86%->64% BUT audited the 65 false predictions (3-agent transcript classification, scratchpad/measure2/t1py-false-preds.json): 26 gold_miss (40% = real ads gold MISSED) + 32 real_fp (49%) + 7 ambiguous (11% first-party/network promos). => TRUE precision = 143/182 = 78.6% (82.4% w/ first-party), genuine false-BANNER rate 17.6%. t1py is a BIG win + close to flag-on-able (4.4x coverage @ ~79% real precision, markOnly=never skips). FP-REDUCTION LEVER: the 32 real_fps cluster STRUCTURALLY on episode-edge + inter-segment music (cold-open/intro branding, outro credits, theme music, interview/segment transitions; chris-hayes "welcome back to our series" over music = archetype) -> a POSITION/CONTEXT gate (suppress proposals at intro/outro/credits/transitions) lifts precision toward ~85-90% far cleaner than a confidence threshold (conf separates only weakly: false median 0.576 vs true 0.765, no clean cut). NEXT: t1py FP-refinement bead (position gate) before flag-on; uxte retune still pending.

title: Certainty-tiered skip gate: rediff-anchored DAI -> auto-skip; host-read -> skip-if-confident-else-markOnly
notes:
MEASUREMENT-BACKED (greedy #1, 10-ep subset, 2026-07-17). Implements Dan certainty-tiered policy [[feedback_certainty_tiered_skip]]. Real dump evidence: 30 eligible windows split cleanly into TWO populations by rediff-anchor + skipConfidence: (A) 14 rediff-anchored = long DAI breaks 60-114s, skipConfidence ~1.0 (smartless/morbid/conan/planet-money/business-wars/OTM mid-rolls) -> SKIP confidently. (B) 16 non-rediff = short 2-36s, mostly HOST-READS (themove Tofosi@2662/Ventum@3455 conf~1.0; doac Helix@50/Pipedrive@2888; unexplained/OTM fragments conf 0.28-0.65). skipConfidence ALREADY separates skip-worthy (themove 0.96-1.0) from banner-worthy (doac 0.55, OTM 2s @0.28). IMPL: eligible = (rediffSlot in anchorProvenance) OR (skipConfidence >= T); else markOnly. rediff anchor = the DAI high-certainty flag; skipConfidence = the host-read skip-vs-mark dial. Threshold T to be calibrated (candidate ~0.8-0.9). Also confirmed this run: FIX A working (conan [0-88] intro over-anchor GONE, windows now at real breaks 1201/2677/3850); Option-1/xsdz.59 = 0 eligible windows held on <2 non-FM kinds (FM never load-bearing for a skip). Dump: scratchpad/promptiter/measurement-greedy1-dump.json.
CALIBRATION FINDING (greedy #1, 10-ep): gate = eligible if (rediffSlot) OR (skipConfidence>=T) else markOnly. DAI HALF IS CLEAN + implementable now: 14 rediff-anchored windows = long DAI breaks, all high-conf, skip. HOST-READ THRESHOLD needs care: cannot calibrate T against GOLD because gold under-annotates host-reads (themove Tofosi/NXT/Ventum show gold-ad=False = a GOLD GAP, not a false positive - gold breaks are DAI-focused). Cross-ref vs my themove/doac host-read labels instead: true host-reads span conf 0.55-1.0 (Tofosi 1.0, NXT 0.98, Ventum 0.96, Helix 0.81 = confident; Pipedrive 0.55-0.71 = uncertain); 2s fragments (OTM @1114 conf 0.28, unexplained @2598 0.52) sit low. T~0.8 skips the confident host-reads + rediff-DAI, banners the uncertain host-reads (Pipedrive) + fragments = exactly the safe-degradation policy. PREREQ for a rigorous T: a host-read-labeled calibration set (gold cannot provide it; connect to l2f.9 second-listener attestation or a manual host-read gold extending the themove fixture). IMPL: the DAI-rediff-skip rule can land now; the host-read confidence gate lands after the calibration set.
IMPL LOCATION (2026-07-17): the eligibility gate (BackfillEvidenceFusion.computeGate:954) is pure evidence-QUORUM and deliberately does NOT see skipConfidence ("gate NEVER modifies score", :953). So wraj = a POST-gate CONFIDENCE DOWNGRADE: after computeGate returns .eligible, downgrade to .markOnly when the span is NON-rediff-anchored AND skipConfidence < T. Candidate site = AutoSkipPrecisionGate.swift (name = exactly this role). BLOCKER: T needs a host-read-labeled calibration set (gold under-annotates host-reads). Rediff-anchored windows already reach .eligible via quorum, so the DAI-skip half is already live; the NEW behavior (downgrade uncertain non-rediff host-reads to banner) is what needs T. SEQUENCE: build host-read gold -> calibrate T -> implement the downgrade in AutoSkipPrecisionGate. Do NOT implement with a guessed T (would change skip behavior on a guess).
T CALIBRATION #1 (themove host-reads, 2026-07-17): ran the treatment lane on all 3 themove episodes (pure host-read show), labeled the 10 non-rediff (host-read-lane) windows against 13 known sponsor-read ranges. T-sweep: T=0.7 skips 8/8 reads but ALSO both non-read windows (bad); T=0.9 skips 7/8 reads + banners BOTH non-read windows (@1686 conf 0.83, @2434 conf 0.73) + safely degrades 1 uncertain read (Ventum@2626 conf 0.78) to banner. => RECOMMENDED T ~= 0.9 for the non-rediff host-read floor in AutoSkipPrecisionGate. All 10 host-read windows are currently .eligible (would auto-skip); wraj+T=0.9 downgrades the 3 lowest-conf to markOnly = exactly the certainty-tiered policy. CAVEAT: first calibration, small set (~16 host-read windows total incl the 10-ep doac data where Tofosi 1.0->skip, Pipedrive 0.55-0.71->banner is consistent). A production T needs a larger host-read-labeled set, but 0.9 is a defensible, safe starting floor (conservative = banners more). NEXT: implement the rediff-aware confidence floor in AutoSkipPrecisionGate (rediff-anchored: low floor ~existing; non-rediff: floor=0.9), behind a flag, then re-measure the eligible->markOnly deltas.
IMPLEMENTATION SPEC (review-loop-ready, 2026-07-17). Change is localized to AutoSkipPrecisionGate.swift + its one caller. STEPS: (1) AutoSkipPrecisionGateInput: add "let rediffAnchored: Bool" (init default false for back-comaptibility). (2) AutoSkipPrecisionGateConfig: add "let hostReadConfidenceFloor: Double" (default 0.9 per themove calibration) + a feature flag "let certaintyTieredEnabled: Bool" (default FALSE). (3) classify(): after the existing Layer gates, add: if config.certaintyTieredEnabled && !input.rediffAnchored && input.segmentScore < config.hostReadConfidenceFloor -> return the markOnly classification (downgrade). rediff-anchored spans keep the existing (lower) floor = skip. (4) Thread rediffAnchored from the caller (AdDetectionService, where the span anchorProvenance is available): rediffAnchored = span.anchorProvenance contains .rediffSlot. (5) VERIFY THE SCORE MAPPING: the calibration used the dump field skipConfidence; confirm classify input.segmentScore is the SAME quantity (AdSegmentCandidate.segmentScore / ClassifierResult.adProbability) OR remap T. If they differ, re-derive T from the gate score. (6) Flag OFF by default; measure the eligible->markOnly delta on the treatment lane before defaulting ON. TEST PLAN: unit tests for the new branch (rediff-anchored bypasses floor; non-rediff below 0.9 -> markOnly; non-rediff >=0.9 -> eligible; flag OFF = byte-identical to today); re-run treatment lane, expect ~3/10 host-read-lane windows downgrade skip->banner. RUN VIA the iterative-review-loop skill (cap=20 per project standing instruction) since it is a skip-path change.
CRITICAL CORRECTION (2026-07-17, from implementer adversarial review): the AutoSkipPrecisionGate (hot-path) is the WRONG SITE. It is pre-fusion so (a) it never sees anchorProvenance/.rediffSlot (rediff anchors are stamped later on the fusion/backfill DecodedSpan) and (b) its segmentScore (raw adProbability, poorly calibrated) is NOT the skipConfidence that T=0.9 was calibrated on. First implementer built a clean flag-off tested version there (branch worktree-agent-a1c2f93276d648537, commit d87f8acc, 26/26+34/34 green) but it is SUPERSEDED - useful as a pattern only. CORRECT SITE = BackfillEvidenceFusion.swift:810-825 (the DecisionMapper decision-build): both the gate (from computeGate(), which reads span.anchorProvenance) AND skipConfidence are in scope right before the DecisionResult return. This RESOLVES BOTH RISKS: rediff visible via anchorProvenance, and skipConfidence IS the exact field the dump/T=0.9 calibration used. CORRECTED IMPL: after gate=computeGate() and skipConfidence computed (~:814-816), add flag-gated: if certaintyTieredEnabled && gate == .eligible && !span.anchorProvenance.contains(.rediffSlot) && skipConfidence < hostReadConfidenceFloor(0.9) { gate = .markOnly }. Config fields on the DecisionMapper/fusion config, default flag OFF. T=0.9 is now DIRECTLY valid (same field). Tests: the fusion-path decision tests; verify flag-off byte-identical + the 3/10 themove downgrade.
T=0.9 VALIDITY CONFIRMED for the corrected site (2026-07-17). Traced: the measurement dump (backfill/treatment lane) sets each window skipConfidence from decision.skipConfidence (AdDetectionService:4344/4394/4431) = the fusion effectiveConfidence at BackfillEvidenceFusion:816 (= min(1, calibrate(proposalConfidence)*correctionFactor)). The corrected wraj downgrade reads that SAME local skipConfidence. So T=0.9 (calibrated on the dump field) is DIRECTLY valid at the corrected site - no re-fit needed. (The hot-path skipConfidence=result.adProbability at :2877/2883 is the DIFFERENT field the first, wrong-site impl saw.) Corrected design fully verified: site=fusion, rediff visible via anchorProvenance, T=0.9 valid, flag-off byte-identical, 4-line change. Re-dispatching corrected implementer.
IMPLEMENTED CORRECTLY (2026-07-17) at the fusion site. Branch worktree-agent-a81f380cf102450cd, commit 5d8d5eff (NOT merged/pushed). Change: DecisionMapper.map in BackfillEvidenceFusion.swift - flag-gated post-gate downgrade (gate .eligible -> .markOnly when certaintyTieredEnabled && !rediff-anchored && skipConfidence < hostReadConfidenceFloor). Config: FusionWeightConfig gains certaintyTieredEnabled(false) + hostReadConfidenceFloor(0.9), threaded with defaults => all 4 existing FusionWeightConfig() sites byte-identical. TESTS: 72 focused (BackfillEvidenceFusionTests) + 70 regression across 6 suites, all pass. Proven: flag-off byte-identical (gate never reassigned), rediff bypass works, at/above-floor eligible, custom-floor honored (not hardcoded), blocked-span untouched, scores never modified. FLOAT-BOUNDARY INSIGHT: skipConfidence is a SUM of ledger weights, so a ~0.9 span can be 0.8999.. (IEEE) and correctly banner under strict <0.9 - fine for safe-degradation (ties -> banner); if exactly-0.9-should-skip is desired, add a tiny epsilon. REMAINING TO SHIP: (1) surface certaintyTieredEnabled=true at the AdDetectionService FusionWeightConfig() construction + settings/flag plumbing (out of scope, intentionally); (2) re-measure the treatment lane with flag ON to confirm ~3/10 host-read-lane windows downgrade skip->banner; (3) Dan greenlight + larger host-read set to tighten T. SUPERSEDES the hot-path attempt (branch worktree-agent-a1c2f93276d648537 / d87f8acc - abandon).
POST-ROLL DE-PRIORITIZATION (Dan, 2026-07-19): post-roll ads are the LEAST important to skip (user can just jump to next episode), so wraj must NOT auto-skip post-roll DAI even when rediff-anchored — banner/markOnly it instead. Rationale + asymmetry: a correct post-roll skip saves little (user is already at episode end); a WRONG post-roll skip cuts the hosts closing content near the end = bad. So banner post-roll regardless of certainty. IMPL: add a position guard to the DecisionMapper downgrade at BackfillEvidenceFusion — near-end spans (end >= duration - ~90s) downgrade eligible->markOnly even if rediff-anchored. POSITION-SPLIT DATA (2026-07-19, 24-ep gold, coverage program captures): gold ad-width is 20% pre / 66% MID / 13% post — the corpus is MID-ROLL-dominated, NOT post-roll. FM recovery gains land 86% mid+pre / only 14% post. So de-prioritizing post-roll costs almost nothing (13% of width, low value) and removes end-of-episode false-skip risk. Valuable (mid+pre) coverage @ FM-1x = 46%; mid-roll is the biggest gap (66% of width, 43% covered) = the real auto-skip target. Needs episode duration at the fusion site (capture has duration_seconds per ep).
GATE-DELTA MEASUREMENT COMPLETE (2026-07-19, wraj-gate-deltas.md): treatment lane flag-ON vs frozen greedy-#1 reference — 32/32 windows predicted-vs-observed AGREE with T=0.9 + 90s post-roll; 30->20 eligible (8 floor + 1 post-roll + 2 both); post-roll correctly demoted the themove closer at conf 1.000 REDIFF-ANCHORED (the rediff-exemption override works); 0/20 survivors violate the predicate; no gate-attributable score drift (14 rediff windows byte-identical). REMAINING TO SHIP (Gate 2): (1) surface certaintyTieredEnabled in production config — DAN DECISION; (2) larger host-read calibration set to firm T=0.9 (two themove reads drifted to within ~0.03 of the floor; OTM window kept only via rediff anchor); (3) compose with 98co start-padding + veto masks + 3-run reproducibility per xsdz.36 ladder.
SURFACING MERGED (2026-07-20, PR #245, bce53132): certaintyTieredSkipEnabled/hostReadConfidenceFloor/postRollGuardSeconds now on AdDetectionConfig, default-inert. Gate-2 enablement (Dan) still blocked on: hdgk anchor-provenance stamping + 98co start-padding (merged, dormant) + veto masks + larger host-read T-calibration set + 3-run reproducibility.

title: FM coarse-scan prompt precision: add third-party-ownership definition + brand+CTA heuristic + intro/theme/monologue negatives (over-anchor correctness fix)
notes:
ROOT CAUSE of FM over-anchoring intros (Opus prompt analysis 2026-07-17): the COARSE-SCAN prompt (PermissiveAdClassifier.swift:211 — the first pass that FLAGS regions) has NO definition of 'ad' (only structural line-ref formatting examples) and uses the dangerously broad word 'PROMOTIONAL' ('ad / sponsorship / promotional read'). A host intro ('welcome to the show, my guest is a rock legend, new album out now'), a Mick Jagger cold-open bit, and a theme song (garbled lyrics 'fall is here hear the yell') all read as 'promotional' to a 3B model. The third-party-vs-show OWNERSHIP test exists only DOWNSTREAM in the labeling prompt (ownership:thirdParty/show, FoundationModelClassifier.swift:1999) NOT in the coarse scan; its ONE negative example (cross-promo 'our other show') doesn't cover intros/theme/monologue. FIXES: (1) real ad DEFINITION at top of coarse scan, anchored on THIRD-PARTY OWNERSHIP + call-to-action; (2) delete 'promotional' -> 'third-party sponsored advertisement'; (3) executable heuristic: 'an ad names a third-party brand AND has a purchase CTA (URL/promo code/discount); neither present -> show content'; (4) negative few-shots for the failure classes (cold-open/comedic bit/celebrity banter; theme song w/ garbled lyrics; host opening monologue + guest intro), each vs a real third-party read; (5) name the show-open as a known trap. CAVEATS: fixes CORRECTNESS (over-anchor rate) not DETERMINISM (pairs with xsdz.60/61); weak-model ceiling remains (durable answer = distilled specialist); a prompt change bumps the ScanCohort promptHash -> RESETS the FM rollout-cohort approval (ApprovedCohortRegistry) — versioned change, not silent. NOTE: coarse-refine prompt (:389) already says 'do not include surrounding host content' — good, but it refines AFTER the coarse over-flag.
OVERNIGHT: DRAFT the revised coarse-scan prompt autonomously (definition + brand+CTA heuristic + 4 negatives). Do NOT ship — a prompt change bumps the ScanCohort promptHash and resets the FM rollout cohort; present the draft for Dan's approval.
PRIORITY (Dan 2026-07-17): IDLE-ONLY overnight — draft only if the critical path (xsdz.36.1.1 instrumentation → worst-of-3 re-run → xsdz.59 Option-1 decision) and the kill-tests are all in flight with nothing else productive to do. Lowest autonomous priority; ship-gated regardless.
PROMPT PROGRAM CONVERGED (overnight 2026-07-17). Champion = iter5, saved at scratchpad/promptiter/CHAMPION-iter5-prompt.txt. 5 iterations against the env-gated FM prompt-eval harness (real on-device FM, greedy). Generalized fixes derived from over-reach transcripts (Dan ask): (1) ownership beats CTA (first-party book/merch/app with buy-now link = NO_AD); (2) soft third-party promo is still an ad (underwriting, "brought to you by", cross-network show/app, pharma drug ads) even with NO CTA; (3) BRAND-VOICE test — first-person "we/our" corporate copy or slogan/URL/price = AD; third-person narrative ABOUT a company (a sports team like "Red Bull went all in", a company in the news) = content; (4) commit-over-hedge (do not retreat to UNCERTAIN just because an ad is messy/legalese/partial); (5) guest-work editorial = NO_AD.
RESULTS (correct / FP-rate / recall, greedy-deterministic throughout): tuned-23 0.957/0.000/0.917; held-out-1 (27 unseen-show windows) 0.889/0.000/0.786; held-out-2 (24 fresh, UNBIASED) 0.708/0.000/0.643. FP=0.000 on EVERY set from iter2 on — content-eating cardinal sin robustly avoided.
KEY FINDING: the curated 23-seg eval maxed at 100% but was OVERFIT (held-out fell to 0.74 raw). Prompt engineering drove FP->0 and made it deterministic, but ad-RECALL on unseen shows plateaus ~64-79% regardless of prompt polish = the weak on-device FM CAPABILITY FLOOR. Misses are (a) UNCERTAIN hedges on produced-DAI ads WITH urls/"sponsored by" (Schwab/Amazon/airtasker/underwriting), (b) trailers + host-read setups read as narrative. Nearly all misses are produced-DAI (rediff/byte territory) or boundary-ambiguous; clean host-reads (doac/themove) mostly caught. Quantifies Dan distillation thesis + validates division of labor (deterministic carries produced-DAI, FM owns host-read residual). NOTE held-out labels needed hand-audit: gold-recall gaps mislabeled 3 real ads as NO_AD (Progressive, K-18, Kisqali) — relabeled. NOT wired to production PermissiveAdGrammar yet (reviewed change; Dan sees generalization caveat first).
iter6 experiment (definitive close): added HARD RULE "named third-party + URL/promo-code/price/sponsored-by => ALWAYS AD, never UNCERTAIN". Tuned 0.913/FP0, held-out-1 0.963/FP0/R.929 (converted radiolab+nikki hedges), but held-out-2 REGRESSED to 0.667/FP0/R.571 - it flipped morbid-listener-tales AD->UNCERTAIN despite the window containing "NJM.com", the exact signal the rule calls conclusive. The weak FM applied the SAME explicit rule INCONSISTENTLY across windows. Definitive: the hedge is model-capability, not prompt wording. FP stayed 0 on all sets (rule is safe, just not obeyed). CHAMPION stays iter5 (more stable, wins the unbiased held-out-2). Prompt program CONVERGED - further tweaks trade one show hedge for another. Overall held-out (51 seg): iter5 0.804, iter6 0.824 = within-noise wash.

Recommend (c)+(a).
